# PDF Master — design direction

**Direction:** Apple macOS Sequoia / iPadOS Freeform & Preview precision glass studio.
**One line:** the page is the hero; every control is a translucent instrument floating a few millimetres above it, and nothing competes with the document.

This file is the contract for anything visual. If a change does not fit here, change this file first.

---

## 1. Personality

| Trait | It means | It never means |
|---|---|---|
| **Precise** | Millimetre truth, crisp 1 px borders, tabular numbers, calibrated scales. | Clinical, grey, spreadsheet. |
| **Calm** | One accent colour, quiet motion, generous space around the sheet. | Empty, low contrast, hiding controls. |
| **Tactile** | Glass, soft inner light, paper-like shadows, real hover/press states. | Skeuomorphic leather, fake stitching, embossed bevels. |
| **Confident** | Controls sit where a professional's hand expects them; labels are verbs. | Shouting, badges everywhere, decoration as hierarchy. |
| **Alive** | Depth comes from light (glows, blur, saturation), not from more boxes. | Neon, animation for its own sake. |

Voice: short, literal, no exclamation marks. "Save as stamp", not "Save your stamp!". Units and numbers are shown as values (`1:50`, `300 DPI`), never explained in prose inside a control.

---

## 2. Spatial system

- **Frame:** 8 px outer margin around every surface. Panels are `m-2`, corners `rounded-2xl` (16 px).
- **Radii:** 16 px panels, 18 px tool rail, 12 px pills/fields, 10 px icon buttons, 999 px chips, 2 px paper (paper is paper).
- **Density:** 26 px chips, 28–32 px icon buttons, 34 px pills, 56 px top bar, 13 px base text (11.5 px in chips, 10.5 px in status metadata).
- **Spacing:** 4 px grid; 6 px between icon buttons, 8 px between groups, 12 px inside panels.
- **Elevation:** three steps only — `--shadow-soft` (hover), `--shadow` (floating chrome), `--paper-shadow` (the sheet). Never invent a fourth.

---

## 3. Colour

Three themes, one token set. Accent is system blue in light/dark, burnt sienna in sepia; nothing else is allowed to be saturated.

| Token | Light | Dark | Sepia | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--bg` | `#dfe5ef` | `#090b10` | `#efe4cf` | App backdrop |
| `--glass` | `rgba(255,255,255,.58)` | dark glass | warm glass | Panels, toolbars |
| `--glass-strong` | `.78` | stronger | stronger | Popovers, floating bars |
| `--fg` | `#14161b` | near-white | `#3a2f22` | Text |
| `--muted` | `#6a7280` | grey | `#8a775e` | Secondary text, idle icons |
| `--border` | 10 % ink | 2–3 % white | 14 % ink | Every hairline |
| `--accent` | `#0a84ff` | `#0a84ff` | `#b0552a` | Selection, active tool, focus |
| `--paper` | `#fffdf8` | `#f7f7f5` | `#fffaf0` | The document sheet |
| `--danger` / `--success` | `#ff453a` / `#30d158` | same | `#b3261e` / `#4c7a34` | Destructive / confirmation |

Rules:
1. Max **one** accent-filled surface in view at a time (active tool, or primary button).
2. Ink for annotation colour comes from the document's palette, never from the chrome palette.
3. Glows (`--glow-1..3`) are ambient light behind the sheet. They never sit on a control.
4. Text on glass must clear 4.5:1; `--muted` is for metadata, not for the only label of a control.
5. `color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 24%, transparent)` is the standard accent tint — do not hand-pick new alphas.

---

## 4. Type

- Family: `Inter Variable`, fallback SF Pro / Segoe UI. No second family, no display serif.
- Scale: 10.5 metadata · 11.5 chips/labels · 13 body · 15 panel titles · 18 dialog titles. No 20+ except empty-state headings.
- Weight: 500 for controls, 600 for titles, 400 for prose. Never 700+.
- Numbers that move (page count, zoom, measurements, dimensions) use tabular figures.
- Labels are sentence case. Micro-labels may be ALL CAPS at 10 px with 0.06 em tracking — maximum two per panel.

---

## 5. Light, glass, paper

- Glass = translucent fill + 1 px `--border` + `--shadow` + `inset 0 1px 0 var(--edge)` + `backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(170%)` (`34px` for `.glass-strong`).
- Blur is for chrome over the canvas. Never blur the paper or anything inside it.
- The sheet gets `--paper-shadow` and a 2 px radius; it is the only object allowed a large shadow.
- Paper recipes (129 parametric styles) are drawn as SVG ink, never as background images.
- No gradients on controls. Gradients belong to the ambient glows and the app icon only.

---

## 6. Motion

- Durations: 120–160 ms for state, 220–260 ms for entrances (`anim-in`), 0 ms for measurement readouts.
- Easing: `ease` / `ease-out`. No bounce, no spring, no overshoot on chrome.
- What moves: panel entrance (opacity + 6 px rise), toast, popover origin, selection handles. What does not: the sheet during zoom (transform only), ink while drawing, text while typing.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` collapses everything to 0.01 ms (already enforced globally).
- Print is motionless: `@media print` hides `.top-bar`, `.sidebar`, `.tool-rail`, `.inspector`, `.status-line`, `.selection-chrome`, `.snapshot-bar`, `.crop-overlay`, `.presentation-bar` and flattens `.viewport`, `.page-stage`, `.page-paper`.

---

## 7. Component grammar

- **Icon button:** Lucide, 16 px, `strokeWidth 1.75`, `--muted` → `--fg` on hover, accent tint + accent icon when `aria-pressed`.
- **Chip:** pill, 26 px, transparent with hairline; active state is accent tint, never solid accent.
- **Segmented control:** track (`--track`) with a 24 px thumb per option; the chosen option is the only filled child.
- **Tool rail:** vertical glass column, groups separated by a 24 px hairline, tooltip to the right with name + shortcut.
- **Panels:** header row (icon + title + close), scroll body, footer actions. Hairlines between regions, never cards inside cards.
- **Popovers:** `.glass-strong`, 16 px radius, 8 px offset from trigger, arrowless.
- **Toast:** bottom centre, 10 px from the edge, auto-dismiss, one line, no icon except on failure.
- **Focus:** 2 px `--accent` outline at 2 px offset on `:focus-visible` only.

Every icon-only control carries `aria-label` and `title`. Every toggle carries `aria-pressed`.

---

## 8. Anti-patterns (reject on sight)

- More than one accent colour, or accent used for decoration.
- Solid opaque panels on the canvas; a second card inside a panel.
- Pure `#000` text or `#fff` panels in light theme; pure `#fff` text in dark theme.
- Drop shadows on text, borders on borders, or radii mixed inside one row.
- Bouncy springs, blur-in animations, skeleton shimmer.
- Sentence-length helper text inside a toolbar. Help belongs in tooltips, empty states, or Settings.
- New bespoke button/input classes when `.chip`, `.icon-btn`, `.pill`, `.seg` already cover it.
- Hiding the page behind chrome; the sheet must always keep at least 60 % of the canvas width at 1440 px.

---

## 9. Review checklist

1. Does it read at a glance in all three themes?
2. Is the page still the brightest, largest object?
3. One accent, one shadow step, one radius family?
4. Keyboard reachable, labelled, focus-visible?
5. Does it survive `@media print` and `prefers-reduced-motion`?
6. Would removing it lose information? If not, remove it.

    # "backups",
    # "old_code"

# 2. Ignore files by name or pattern anywhere in the project (supports wildcards like "*.bak")
$CustomIgnoredFiles = @(
    # "notes.txt",
    # "*.bak"
)

# 3. Ignore specific relative paths (folders or files) from the project root
$CustomIgnoredPaths = @(
    # "src\chess_master\web\assets\fonts",
    # "scripts\create_shortcut.ps1"

# --- B) SMART TOKEN OPTIMIZATION SWITCHES ---

$AiIgnoreFile = Join-Path $ProjectRoot ".aiignore"
if (Test-Path $AiIgnoreFile) {
    Get-Content -LiteralPath $AiIgnoreFile -Encoding UTF8 | ForEach-Object {
        $Rule = $_.Trim()
        if ($Rule -and -not $Rule.StartsWith("#")) {
            if ($Rule.Contains("/") -or $Rule.Contains("\")) {
                $CustomIgnoredPaths += $Rule.TrimEnd('/', '\')
            } elseif ($Rule.Contains(".")) {
                $CustomIgnoredFiles += $Rule
            } else {
                $CustomIgnoredDirs += $Rule
            }
        }
    }
}

# ==============================================================================
# 3. HELPER & SMART SUMMARIZER FUNCTIONS
# ==============================================================================

function Format-FileSize {
    param([long]$Bytes)
    if ($Bytes -lt 1024) { return "$Bytes B" }
    elseif ($Bytes -lt 1048576) { return "{0:N1} KB" -f ($Bytes / 1024) }
    else { return "{0:N2} MB" -f ($Bytes / 1048576) }
}

function Normalize-RelPath {
    param([string]$PathStr)
    return ($PathStr -replace '/', '\').Trim('\')
}

function Test-MatchesCustomPath {
    param([string]$RelPath)
    $NormRel = Normalize-RelPath -PathStr $RelPath
    foreach ($Pattern in $CustomIgnoredPaths) {
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Pattern)) { continue }
        $NormPattern = Normalize-RelPath -PathStr $Pattern
        if ($NormRel -like $NormPattern -or $NormRel.StartsWith("$NormPattern\", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
            return $true
        }
    }
    return $false
}

function Test-IsIgnoredDir {
    param([System.IO.DirectoryInfo]$Dir, [string]$RelDirPath)
    $DirName = $Dir.Name

    # 1. Check Custom User Exclusions first
    foreach ($Pattern in $CustomIgnoredDirs) {
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Pattern) -and ($DirName -like $Pattern)) {
            return "Custom User Ignored Dir"
        }
    }
    if (Test-MatchesCustomPath -RelPath $RelDirPath) {
        return "Custom User Ignored Path"
    }

    # 2. Check Built-in Smart Exclusions
    if ($IgnoredDirs.Contains($DirName)) { return "System/Dependency/Build Dir" }
    if ($DirName.EndsWith(".egg-info", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return "Build Metadata Dir" }
    if ($DirName.EndsWith(".dist-info", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return "Build Metadata Dir" }
    if ($DirName.EndsWith(".framework", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return "Framework Binary Dir" }
    if ($SkipDocsAndLicenses -and $DirName -eq "docs") { return "Historical Docs/Screenshots Dir" }

    if ($Dir.Parent -and $Dir.Parent.Name -eq "skills" -and $ExternalLockedSkills.Contains($DirName)) {
        return "External Third-Party Skill (skills-lock.json)"
    }
    return $null
}

function Test-IsCustomIgnoredFile {
    param([System.IO.FileInfo]$File, [string]$RelPath)
    foreach ($Pattern in $CustomIgnoredFiles) {
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Pattern) -and ($File.Name -like $Pattern)) {
            return $true
        }
    }
    if (Test-MatchesCustomPath -RelPath $RelPath) {
        return $true
    }
    return $false
}

function Test-IsBinaryFile {
    param([System.IO.FileInfo]$File)
    if ($BinaryAndAssetExtensions.Contains($File.Extension)) { return $true }
    if ($File.Length -eq 0) { return $false }

    try {
        $SampleSize = [Math]::Min([int]$File.Length, 4096)
        $Buffer = New-Object byte[] $SampleSize
        $Stream = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($File.FullName)
        $BytesRead = $Stream.Read($Buffer, 0, $SampleSize)
        $Stream.Close()
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $BytesRead; $i++) {
            if ($Buffer[$i] -eq 0) { return $true }
        }
        return $false
    } catch {
        return $true
    }
}

function Detect-ProjectStack {
    param([string]$Root)
    $Stack = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    if ((Test-Path "$Root\pyproject.toml") -or (Test-Path "$Root\requirements.txt") -or (Test-Path "$Root\setup.py")) { $Stack.Add("Python") }
    if (Test-Path "$Root\package.json") { $Stack.Add("Node.js / JavaScript") }
    if (Test-Path "$Root\tsconfig.json") { $Stack.Add("TypeScript") }
    if (Test-Path "$Root\Cargo.toml") { $Stack.Add("Rust") }
    if (Test-Path "$Root\go.mod") { $Stack.Add("Go (Golang)") }
    if ((Get-ChildItem -Path $Root -Filter "*.csproj" -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -or (Get-ChildItem -Path $Root -Filter "*.sln" -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $Stack.Add(".NET / C#") }
    if ((Test-Path "$Root\pom.xml") -or (Test-Path "$Root\build.gradle") -or (Test-Path "$Root\build.gradle.kts")) { $Stack.Add("Java / Kotlin") }
    if (Test-Path "$Root\composer.json") { $Stack.Add("PHP") }
    if (Test-Path "$Root\pubspec.yaml") { $Stack.Add("Flutter / Dart") }
    if ((Test-Path "$Root\Dockerfile") -or (Test-Path "$Root\docker-compose.yml") -or (Test-Path "$Root\docker-compose.yaml")) { $Stack.Add("Docker") }

    if ($Stack.Count -eq 0) { return "General Software Project" }
    return ($Stack -join ", ")
}

function Mask-EnvContent {
    param([string[]]$Lines)
    $MaskedLines = foreach ($Line in $Lines) {
        if ($Line -match '^\s*#' -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Line)) {
            $Line
        } elseif ($Line -match '^(\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*=\s*)(.+)$') {
            $KeyPart = $Matches[1]
            $ValPart = $Matches[2].Trim()
            if ($ValPart -in @('true', 'false', 'null', '""', "''", '0', '1', 'development', 'production', 'local')) {
                $Line
            } else {
                "${KeyPart}[REDACTED_SECRET]"
            }
        } else {
            $Line
        }
    }
    return ($MaskedLines -join "`r`n")
}

function Get-SmartTestSummary {
    param([string[]]$Lines, [string]$Ext)
    $Out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $HeadLimit = [Math]::Min($Lines.Count, 12)
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $HeadLimit; $i++) {
        $Trimmed = $Lines[$i].Trim()
        if ($Trimmed.StartsWith('"""') -or $Trimmed.StartsWith('#') -or $Trimmed.StartsWith('//') -or $Trimmed.StartsWith('/*') -or $Trimmed.StartsWith('*')) {
            $Out.Add($Lines[$i])
        }
    }
    $SigCount = 0
    foreach ($Line in $Lines) {
        if ($Line -match '^\s*(async\s+)?def\s+test_' -or
            $Line -match '^\s*class\s+Test' -or
            $Line -match '^\s*@pytest\.fixture' -or
            $Line -match '^\s*(describe|it|test)\s*\(') {
            $Out.Add($Line)
            $SigCount++
        }
    }
    $Out.Add("")
    $Out.Add("# ... [SMART TEST SUMMARY: Extracted $SigCount test/fixture signatures from $($Lines.Count) lines. Set `$SmartSummarizeTests = `$false for full code] ...")
    return ($Out -join "`r`n")
}

function Get-SmartCssSummary {
    param([string[]]$Lines, [string]$SizeStr)
    $Out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $HeadCount = [Math]::Min($Lines.Count, 115)
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $HeadCount; $i++) {
        $Out.Add($Lines[$i])
    }
    $Out.Add("")
    $Out.Add("/* --- EXTRACTED CSS ARCHITECTURE, CUSTOM TOKENS & MEDIA QUERIES --- */")
    $ExtraCount = 0
    for ($i = $HeadCount; $i -lt $Lines.Count; $i++) {
        $Line = $Lines[$i]
        if ($Line -match '^\s*/\*' -or $Line -match '^\s*:[a-zA-Z]' -or $Line -match '^\s*@(media|keyframes|layer|utility)') {
            $Out.Add($Line)
            $ExtraCount++
            if ($ExtraCount -ge 120) { break }
        }
    }
    $Out.Add("/* ... [SMART CSS SUMMARY: Design tokens & section headers extracted from $($Lines.Count) lines ($SizeStr). Set `$SmartSummarizeCSS = `$false for full CSS] ... */")
    return ($Out -join "`r`n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# 4. DIRECTORY TRAVERSAL & TREE GENERATION
# ==============================================================================

$TreeBuilder = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
$IncludedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[PSCustomObject]
$Stats = @{
    CodeFilesCount   = 0
    SummarizedCount  = 0
    BinaryAssetCount = 0
    SkippedDirsCount = 0
}

function Traverse-ProjectDirectory {
    param(
        [string]$CurrentDir,
        [string]$Indent = ""
    )

    $Items = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $CurrentDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
             Where-Object { $_.Name -ne $OutputFileName -and $_.Name -ne "chess_master_source_bundle.txt" -and $_.Name -ne $CurrentScriptName } |
             Sort-Object @{Expression = { -not $_.PSIsContainer }}, Name)

    $Dirs  = @($Items | Where-Object { $_.PSIsContainer })
    $Files = @($Items | Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer })

    $AssetFiles = @()
    $NonAssetFiles = @()
    foreach ($F in $Files) {
        if ($BinaryAndAssetExtensions.Contains($F.Extension)) {
            $AssetFiles += $F
        } else {
            $NonAssetFiles += $F
        }
    }

    $TruncateAssets = $AssetFiles.Count -gt $MaxAssetsPerFolder
    if ($TruncateAssets) {
        $VisibleFiles = $NonAssetFiles + @($AssetFiles | Select-Object -First 5)
    } else {
        $VisibleFiles = $Files
    }

    $ExtraEntry = if ($TruncateAssets) { 1 } else { 0 }
    $TotalVisibleEntries = $Dirs.Count + $VisibleFiles.Count + $ExtraEntry
    $EntryIndex = 0

    # 1. Process Subdirectories
    foreach ($Dir in $Dirs) {
        $EntryIndex++
        $IsLast = ($EntryIndex -eq $TotalVisibleEntries)
        $Branch = if ($IsLast) { $CharLast } else { $CharTee }
        $NextIndent = $Indent + $(if ($IsLast) { $CharSpc } else { $CharPipe })
        $RelDirPath = $Dir.FullName.Substring($ProjectRoot.Length).TrimStart('\', '/')

        $IgnoreReason = Test-IsIgnoredDir -Dir $Dir -RelDirPath $RelDirPath
        if ($IgnoreReason) {
            $Stats.SkippedDirsCount++
            [void]$TreeBuilder.AppendLine("$Indent$Branch$($Dir.Name)/  [Excluded: $IgnoreReason]")
            continue
        }

        [void]$TreeBuilder.AppendLine("$Indent$Branch$($Dir.Name)/")
        Traverse-ProjectDirectory -CurrentDir $Dir.FullName -Indent $NextIndent
    }

    # 2. Process Files
    foreach ($File in $VisibleFiles) {
        $EntryIndex++
        $IsLast = ($EntryIndex -eq $TotalVisibleEntries)
        $Branch = if ($IsLast) { $CharLast } else { $CharTee }
        $RelPath = $File.FullName.Substring($ProjectRoot.Length).TrimStart('\', '/')
        $SizeStr = Format-FileSize -Bytes $File.Length

        if (Test-IsCustomIgnoredFile -File $File -RelPath $RelPath) {
            [void]$TreeBuilder.AppendLine("$Indent$Branch$($File.Name) ($SizeStr) [Skipped: Custom User Ignore]")
            continue
        }

        $IsFontLicense = $SkipDocsAndLicenses -and ($File.Name -like "OFL-*.txt" -or $File.Name -like "LICENSE*")
        if ($LockAndNoiseFiles.Contains($File.Name) -or $IsFontLicense) {
            [void]$TreeBuilder.AppendLine("$Indent$Branch$($File.Name) ($SizeStr) [Skipped: Lock/License/Noise File]")
            continue
        }

        if (Test-IsBinaryFile -File $File) {
            $Stats.BinaryAssetCount++
            [void]$TreeBuilder.AppendLine("$Indent$Branch$($File.Name) ($SizeStr) [Asset/Binary]")
            continue
        }

        [void]$TreeBuilder.AppendLine("$Indent$Branch$($File.Name) ($SizeStr)")

        $IncludedFiles.Add([PSCustomObject]@{
            FileInfo = $File
            RelPath  = $RelPath
        })
    }

    if ($TruncateAssets) {
        $HiddenCount = $AssetFiles.Count - 5
        $Stats.BinaryAssetCount += $HiddenCount
        [void]$TreeBuilder.AppendLine("$Indent$CharLast... (+$HiddenCount more asset/binary files in this folder)")
    }
}

Write-Host "Scanning project structure in: $ProjectRoot ..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
[void]$TreeBuilder.AppendLine("$ProjectName/")
Traverse-ProjectDirectory -CurrentDir $ProjectRoot -Indent ""

# ==============================================================================
# 5. BUILD AI CONTEXT OUTPUT FILE
# ==============================================================================

$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$Builder = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
$DetectedStack = Detect-ProjectStack -Root $ProjectRoot

[void]$Builder.AppendLine("================================================================================")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("AI PROJECT CONTEXT & ARCHITECTURE BUNDLE")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("================================================================================")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("Project Name   : $ProjectName")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("Detected Stack : $DetectedStack")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("Root Path      : $ProjectRoot")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("Generated At   : $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("Included Files : $($IncludedFiles.Count) source/config/data files")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("GUIDE FOR AI ASSISTANT:")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("1. SECTION 1 shows the complete visual directory tree of the project, including")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("   where binary assets, images, fonts, and excluded dependency folders exist.")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("2. SECTION 2 contains the full source code and configuration files. Large data")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("   files (.tsv/.csv), large stylesheets, and test suites are smartly summarized")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("   to preserve context window tokens while retaining 100% architectural clarity.")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("================================================================================")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("")

[void]$Builder.AppendLine("################################################################################")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("# SECTION 1: PROJECT DIRECTORY TREE & ARCHITECTURE")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("################################################################################")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine($TreeBuilder.ToString().TrimEnd())
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("")

[void]$Builder.AppendLine("################################################################################")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("# SECTION 2: SOURCE CODE & CONFIGURATION FILES")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("################################################################################")
[void]$Builder.AppendLine("")

$SortedFiles = $IncludedFiles | Sort-Object `
    @{Expression = { ($_.RelPath -split '[\\/]').Count -gt 1 }}, `
    RelPath

foreach ($Item in $SortedFiles) {
    $File     = $Item.FileInfo
    $RelPath  = $Item.RelPath
    $FullPath = $File.FullName
    $Ext      = $File.Extension.ToLowerInvariant()
    $SizeStr  = Format-FileSize -Bytes $File.Length

    [void]$Builder.AppendLine("================================================================================")
    [void]$Builder.AppendLine("FILE: $RelPath ($SizeStr)")
    [void]$Builder.AppendLine("================================================================================")

    if ($File.Length -eq 0) {
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("[EMPTY FILE]")
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("")
        continue
    }

    try {
        $Lines = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($FullPath, $Utf8NoBom)
    } catch {
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("[ERROR READING FILE: $($_.Exception.Message)]")
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("")
        continue
    }

    $TotalLines = $Lines.Count
    if ($TotalLines -eq 0) {
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("[EMPTY FILE]")
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("")
        continue
    }

    # 1. Mask secrets in .env files
    $IsEnvSecretFile = ($File.Name -like ".env*") -and ($File.Name -notmatch "\.(example|sample|template)$")
    if ($IsEnvSecretFile) {
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("# [SECURITY NOTICE: Secret values have been automatically redacted]")
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine((Mask-EnvContent -Lines $Lines))
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("")
        $Stats.CodeFilesCount++
        continue
    }

    # 2. Accurate Minified / Bundled JS & CSS Detection
    $IsMinifiedName = $File.Name -match "\.(min|bundle|compiled)\.(js|mjs|cjs|css)$"
    $IsMinifiedContent = $false
    if ($Ext -in @(".js", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".css")) {
        $AvgLineLength = $File.Length / [Math]::Max(1, $TotalLines)
        if ($AvgLineLength -gt 300) {
            $IsMinifiedContent = $true
        } else {
            $SampleCheckCount = [Math]::Min($TotalLines, 30)
            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $SampleCheckCount; $i++) {
                if ($Lines[$i].Length -gt 1500) {
                    $IsMinifiedContent = $true
                    break
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if ($IsMinifiedName -or $IsMinifiedContent) {
        $Stats.SummarizedCount++
        $PreviewCount = [Math]::Min($TotalLines, 10)
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $PreviewCount; $i++) {
            $LineText = $Lines[$i]
            if ($LineText.Length -gt 300) {
                $LineText = $LineText.Substring(0, 300) + " ... [LINE TRUNCATED]"
            }
            [void]$Builder.AppendLine($LineText)
        }
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("... [AUTO-TRUNCATED: Minified or Compiled Output ($TotalLines lines, $SizeStr)] ...")
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("")
        continue
    }

    # 3. Smart CSS Token & Architecture Summary for large stylesheets (> 25 KB)
    if ($SmartSummarizeCSS -and $Ext -in @(".css", ".scss") -and $File.Length -gt 25KB) {
        $Stats.SummarizedCount++
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine((Get-SmartCssSummary -Lines $Lines -SizeStr $SizeStr))
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("")
        continue
    }

    # 4. Smart Test Suite Signature Extraction
    $IsTestFile = ($RelPath -match '^(tests?|__tests__|spec)[\\/]') -and ($File.Name -match '(^test_|_test\.|\.test\.|\.spec\.)')
    if ($SmartSummarizeTests -and $IsTestFile) {
        $Stats.SummarizedCount++
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine((Get-SmartTestSummary -Lines $Lines -Ext $Ext))
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("")
        continue
    }

    # 5. Auto-detect Datasets (.tsv, .csv, etc.) or Oversized Data Files
    $IsDatasetFile = $DatasetExtensions.Contains($Ext)
    $IsSourceCode  = $SourceCodeExtensions.Contains($Ext)
    $SizeLimitKB   = if ($IsSourceCode) { $MaxSourceCodeSizeKB } else { $MaxDataFileSizeKB }
    $IsOversized   = ($File.Length / 1KB) -gt $SizeLimitKB

    if ($IsDatasetFile -or $IsOversized) {
        $Stats.SummarizedCount++
        $PreviewCount = [Math]::Min($TotalLines, $DatasetPreviewLines)
        $PreviewLines = for ($i = 0; $i -lt $PreviewCount; $i++) { $Lines[$i] }
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine(($PreviewLines -join "`r`n"))
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("")
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("... [AUTO-TRUNCATED: Showing first $PreviewCount of $TotalLines lines ($SizeStr) to save AI tokens] ...")
        [void]$Builder.AppendLine("")
        continue
    }

    # 6. Full Source Code (with optional SVG icon path compaction in HTML)
    $Stats.CodeFilesCount++
    $Content = ($Lines -join "`r`n").TrimEnd()
    if ($CompactHtmlSvgIcons -and $Ext -in @(".html", ".htm")) {
        $Content = [regex]::Replace($Content, '(<symbol\s+id="[^"]+"[^>]*>)\s*[\s\S]*?\s*(</symbol>)', '$1[SVG_ICON]$2')
    }
    [void]$Builder.AppendLine($Content)
    [void]$Builder.AppendLine("")
}

# Write Final Output
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($OutputFile, $Builder.ToString(), $Utf8NoBom)

# ==============================================================================
# 6. SUMMARY REPORT
# ==============================================================================
$FinalSize = Format-FileSize -Bytes (Get-Item $OutputFile).Length
$EstimatedTokens = [Math]::Round((Get-Item $OutputFile).Length / 4)

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "==================================================================" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
Write-Host "[DONE] AI Context Bundle Successfully Generated!" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "==================================================================" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
Write-Host "Project Name        : $ProjectName" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "Detected Tech Stack : $DetectedStack" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "Full Code Files     : $($Stats.CodeFilesCount) files" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Smart Summarized    : $($Stats.SummarizedCount) files (CSS/Tests/Datasets)" -ForegroundColor Magenta
Write-Host "Binary/Assets Mapped: $($Stats.BinaryAssetCount) files (listed in tree only)" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
Write-Host "Final Bundle Size   : $FinalSize (~$($EstimatedTokens.ToString('N0')) AI tokens)" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Saved To            : $OutputFile" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "==================================================================" -ForegroundColor DarkGray

================================================================================
FILE: PDFMaster-Desktop.cmd
================================================================================
@echo off
rem PDF Master desktop launcher: builds if needed, serves the production bundle
rem and opens it in a frameless Edge/Chrome app window.
setlocal
cd /d "%~dp0"
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%~dp0scripts\launch-desktop.ps1" %*
if errorlevel 1 pause
endlocal

FILE: README.md

# PDF Master

A precision glass studio for PDF and paper annotation: vector ink, shapes, text, LaTeX formulas, calibrated measurements, 464 stamps, snapshots, cropping, bookmarks and presentation mode — in the browser, as an installed PWA, or as a desktop window.

PDF Master is a ground-up rebuild of the behaviour and data model of **PDF Annotator 10.0.0.1011**, replacing its Delphi VCL + PDF-XChange stack with React 19, PDF.js and pdf-lib. The design direction is defined in [`.impeccable.md`](./.impeccable.md).

---

## Quick start

```bash
npm install
npm run dev        # http://localhost:5173
npm run build      # type-check + production bundle in dist/
npm run preview    # serve dist/ on http://localhost:4173
npm test           # 79 unit tests
```

Requires Node 20+ (developed on Node 26, Windows 11).

---

## Feature tour

### Annotation tools

| Tool | Shortcut | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Select | `V` | Select, move, resize, rotate, flip, align; `Ctrl+A` selects the page, `Esc` clears. |
| Lasso | `Q` | Freeform selection over ink and shapes. |
| Pen | `P` | Pressure-sensitive vector ink; snapping, scratch-out erase, ink-on-text. |
| Highlighter | `M` | Broad marker with its own property set (never synchronised with the pen). |
| Text | `T` | In-place text boxes with fill, frame and type styles; `Ctrl+B/I/U`, `Ctrl+M` fit. |
| Line / Arrow | `L` / `A` | 15° snapping with `Shift`, 10 arrowhead and tail shapes. |
| Rectangle / Ellipse | `R` / `O` | Fill, opacity and dash styles; `Shift` for square/circle. |
| Polygon | `G` | Click to add points, `Enter` to close. |
| Dimension | `D` | Distance or area with extension lines, editable scale and unit. |
| Stamp | `S` | 464 factory stamps plus your own; drag, resize, rotate, flip. |
| Eraser | `E` | Whole annotation or split strokes; rapid scribble erases ink underneath. |
| Measure | `U` | Distance, perimeter, area, angle, with calibration scales and unit conversion. |
| Formula | `F` | LaTeX via KaTeX, live preview, editable after insertion. |
| Crop | `C` | Crop the visible page box. |
| Snapshot | `Ctrl+Shift+S` | Copy a region, download it, or save it as a custom stamp. |
| Image | `I` | Place PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG; paste from the clipboard. |
| Hand | `H` | Pan; hold `Space` from any tool. |

### Documents, pages and storage

- Multi-document tabs, per-tab page lists, reorder/duplicate/rotate/delete pages, per-page rotation and crop.
- 129 parametric paper recipes (Blank, Ruled, Squared, Millimetre, Grid) for A4 and Letter, drawn as SVG ink — not images.
- Autosave to IndexedDB, manual `.pmbackup.json` backup (version 2) with tabs, pages, annotations **and** custom stamps, scales, shortcuts, preferences and theme.
- Editable PDF export writes real vector ink, text and shapes plus a `PDFMasterAnnotations` sidecar; flattened export bakes everything into the page tree.
- The page tree is rebuilt on export, so page order, duplicates, crops and rotation survive the round trip.
- Bookmarks and the custom outline are read from imported PDFs and kept in the sidecar across an export/reopen cycle.

### Presentation and output

- Presentation mode (`Ctrl+Shift+P`): full-screen sheet, minimal bottom bar, page stepping.
- Print (`Ctrl+P`, top bar, command palette) prints the active sheet through `@media print`, hiding all chrome.
- PWA manifest with `display: standalone`, `window-controls-overlay` and an inline SVG icon.
- Desktop launch contract compatible with the original: `?new=A4+Landscape&fullscreen=1&print=1`.

---

## PDF Annotator 10 → PDF Master

### Why a rebuild

Phase 1 reconnaissance of the installed product found four stacks glued into one process: a Delphi VCL + DevExpress shell, the closed-source **PDF-XChange Editor SDK 10.8.4.409** (`PDFXEditSimple.x64.dll`, 41.5 MB), **ImageEn 8.1.5.0** for a second imaging path, and an MPRESS-packed executable. The whole application is 93.9 MB across 18 files, with an **8.4 MB XML file** holding 617 tool presets, and annotations persisted as **transparent raster images** at 72–1200 DPI. That is why saving is slow, files bloat, quality depends on a save-time DPI setting, and "melting" annotations exists as a separate command.

PDF Master keeps what was worth keeping — the tool model, presets, stamps, paper recipes and shortcut contract — and replaces the rest with web technology: vector-first, no install-time binary blob, no per-save rasterisation.

### Side-by-side

| Dimension | PDF Annotator 10.0.0.1011 | PDF Master |
|---|---|---|
| Platform | Windows only (x86/x64 native) | Browser, installable PWA, Windows desktop window (Tauri v2) |
| UI stack | Delphi VCL + DevExpress, ~690 bitmap glyphs | React 19 + Tailwind 4, Lucide icons, CSS glass tokens |
| PDF engine | PDF-XChange Editor SDK 10.8.4.409 (closed, GDI) | PDF.js 6 (render) + pdf-lib 1.17 (write), both open |
| Annotation model | Editable sidecar data, saved as transparent images | Vector geometry + images, kept as annotation data and written as vector PDF content |
| Save quality | Fixed by the chosen DPI (72/150/300/600/1200) | Zoom-independent vectors; images at source resolution |
| Install footprint | 93.9 MB, 18 files + language modules | 2.0 MB of JavaScript across 9 chunks (564 kB gzip); 6.9 MB with KaTeX/Inter webfonts |
| Tool presets | 617 presets in an 8.67 MB XML parsed at startup | Same 617 presets and 21 groups, bundled as JSON and split from app code |
| Stamps | 464 GIF stamps hex-encoded inside the XML | 464 PNG stamps in a lazy catalogue chunk, plus user stamps |
| Paper templates | 129 templates in `PAStyleTemplates.xml` | 129 parametric recipes as JSON, drawn as SVG |
| Text | Text boxes rasterised on save | Real PDF text with the same layout model on screen and in export |
| Formulas | LaTeX as ink | KaTeX rendered to PNG at export (same on-screen result) |
| Measurement | Distance/perimeter/area/angle, scale manager | Same four modes, calibrated scale store, unit conversion |
| Persistence | PDF + private editable data; "melt" required | Editable PDF with a `PDFMasterAnnotations` sidecar, or flattened PDF |
| Undo | Per-document history | Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y over pages, annotations and document state |
| Themes | Windows/skin based (PA_DARK / PA_LIGHT / PA_W11) | Light, dark and sepia glass themes |
| Shortcuts | Rebindable with conflict detection | Rebindable with conflict detection, per-command reset, backup included |
| Command line | `PDFAnnotator.exe [file] [/print] [/new:"A4 Landscape"] [/fullscreen]` | Same contract as URL query or arguments, via browser or Tauri |
| Updates | Bundled update wizard | Web deployment; desktop build rebuilt from source |

### What carried over

- Tool families, property semantics (mm, opacity, dash, arrowheads), and the "highlighter never syncs" rule.
- Default shortcuts (`Ctrl+O/S/P`, tool letters, `Shift` modifiers) and the rebindable keymap.
- 129 paper recipes, 617 presets, 464 stamps, 21 groups — migrated in Phase 2, not recreated by hand.
- Print, presentation, page operations, bookmarks, measurement scales and the launch contract.
- The visual goal: a professional annotation desk, not a generic web form.

## Desktop builds

### 1. Zero-dependency launcher (no Rust, no install)

`PDFMaster-Desktop.cmd` → `scripts/launch-desktop.ps1`:

- builds `dist/` when missing or stale (or pass `-Rebuild`),
- serves it with Vite preview on port 4173,
- opens it in a **frameless Edge/Chrome `--app` window** at 1440×900 with its own profile (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\PDFMaster\DesktopProfile`),
- closes the preview server when the window exits.

No address bar, no tabs, no Node prompt. Windows only, requires Edge or Chrome.

### 2. Tauri v2 shell (native installer)

Verified with Rust 1.98.1 (`cargo check` finishes clean).

```bash
winget install Rustlang.Rustup      # once, then reopen the terminal
npm install
npm run build
npx @tauri-apps/cli dev             # development window (loads Vite on 5173)
npx @tauri-apps/cli build           # MSI/NSIS installer + executable
```

`src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`:

- product name **PDF Master**, identifier **com.pdfmaster.desktop**,
- 1440×900 window, minimum 1024×680, centred, resizable, drag-and-drop enabled,
- `frontendDist: ../dist`, `devUrl: http://localhost:5173`,
- bundle target `all` with 32/128/256 px PNG, `.ico` and `.icns` icons.

`src-tauri/src/main.rs` forwards arguments (`--new "A4 Landscape" --fullscreen --print`) into the same query contract the web build understands. Icons are generated from the app mark with `python scripts/make_icons.py` (Pillow); rerun it after changing the logo.

---

## Launch contract (browser and desktop)

| Intent | URL | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| New paper, portrait | `?new=A4` | `--new "A4"` or `/new:"A4"` |
| New paper, landscape | `?new=A4+Landscape` | `--new "A4 Landscape"` |
| Presentation | `?fullscreen=1` | `--fullscreen` |
| Print on open | `?print=1` | `--print` |

- Paper names resolve to the least busy matching recipe (`Blank` → `Ruled` → `Squared` → `Grid`); A4 has a Blank recipe, Letter resolves to a Letter ruled/squared recipe.
- Flags accept `1/true/yes/on`; `0`/`no` keep them off. Empty values are ignored.
- Both spellings (`--flag`, `/flag`, `flag=value`) are parsed by the same tested parser (`src/lib/bootArgs.ts`).

## Architecture

### Stack

| Layer | Libraries |
|---|---|
| UI | React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Lucide icons, Inter Variable |
| State | Zustand 5 stores (documents, tools, annotations, UI) |
| PDF read | PDF.js 6 (`pdfjs-dist`) |
| PDF write | pdf-lib 1.17 |
| Ink | `perfect-freehand` + custom vector paths |
| Formulas | KaTeX |
| Build | Vite 8, TypeScript 7 |
| Tests | Vitest 5 (unit), Playwright/Chromium (headless E2E, run ad hoc) |

### Directory map

```
src/
  App.tsx                  shell: layout, shortcut router, boot args, autosave, export
  components/
    TopBar, Sidebar, ToolBar, Inspector, StatusLine, ZoomPill
    CommandPalette, SettingsModal, NewDocumentModal, StampGallery, PresetGallery
    PresentationBar, ThemeSwitcher
    canvas/
      PaperViewport        pan/zoom/fit, page stage
      PaperSheet           SVG paper recipe
      PdfBackground        rasterised source page
      AnnotationLayer      drawing, selection, snapshot, tools
      SelectionOverlay     handles and mini action bar (Save as stamp, …)
      TextView/TextEditor, FormulaView/FormulaEditor
      MeasureOverlay, CropOverlay, SnapshotBar
    ui/controls.tsx        shared chips, switches, segmented controls
  stores/                  useDocStore, useToolStore, useAnnotationStore, useUIStore
  lib/
    pdfEngine              inspect, render, export, sidecar (encode/load)
    annotationTypes, annotationGeometry, textLayout, ink, paper, pageUtils
    presets, data, tools, sync, images, raster, formula
    measure, customStamps, prefs, shortcuts, bootArgs
    storage               IndexedDB autosave, v1/v2 workspace backups
  data/                    617 presets, 464 stamps, 129 paper recipes, 21 groups
src-tauri/                 Tauri v2 shell (config, capabilities, icons, Rust entry)
scripts/                   launch-desktop.ps1, make_icons.py, conversion tooling
public/                    manifest.webmanifest, icon.svg, stamp assets
```

### Data flow

1. **Open** — PDF.js renders the source page into a canvas; `inspectPdf` reads page sizes and outline entries; the sidecar is restored if present.
2. **Annotate** — the SVG annotation layer keeps geometry in page millimetres; zoom scales the wrapper, never the data.
3. **Autosave** — documents and annotations are written to IndexedDB; preference stores (stamps, scales, shortcuts, prefs, theme) live in `localStorage`.
4. **Export** — `exportPdf` rebuilds the page tree, draws paper, annotations and rotation, then embeds either the editable sidecar or flattened content.
5. **Backup** — `workspaceBackup` collects documents plus every preference store into a version 2 `.pmbackup.json`.

### Persistence

| Layer | Key / file | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| IndexedDB `pdf-master/workspace/current` | `current` | tabs, pages, annotations, active tab |
| IndexedDB `pdf-master/pdf-blobs` | tab id | imported PDF bytes, kept out of the structural save |
| `localStorage` | `pm.customStamps`, `pm.measure.scales`, `pm.measure.active`, `pm.shortcuts`, `pm.prefs`, `pa.theme` | studio preferences |
| PDF sidecar | `/PDFMasterAnnotations` info key, `pm1:` + base64 JSON | page map, annotations, bookmarks |
| Workspace backup | `*.pmbackup.json` (version 2) | everything above |

Version 1 backups (tabs only) still import; missing stores are left untouched.

## Testing and verification

| Check | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Type-check | `npx tsc -b` | clean |
| Unit tests | `npm test` | 14 files, 79 tests passing |
| Production build | `npm run build` | clean, no warnings, 997 ms |
| Tauri shell | `cargo check` (in `src-tauri`) | `Finished dev profile` |
| Headless E2E | Chromium via Playwright | 28/28 checks, 0 console/page errors |

The E2E pass covers: PWA manifest, drawing ink, selection → save as stamp, stamp-tool switch, v2 backup export, backup import restoring stamps/scales/shortcuts/preferences/theme, `Ctrl+P` firing print, `@media print` hiding the chrome, `?new=Letter+Landscape&fullscreen=1` boot, and `?print=1`.

Unit coverage includes annotation geometry, text layout, ink paths, measurement conversion, shortcut normalisation/conflicts, PDF export and sidecar round-trips (including bookmarks), boot-argument parsing, workspace backup round-trips, and store-level undo/selection.

## Known limitations

- **Formula export is raster.** KaTeX depends on fonts/styles that do not load inside the isolated SVG raster document; native MathML renders at the cost of a PNG. Text stays vector.
- **Bookmarks are sidecar-only.** pdf-lib has no outline API, so custom bookmarks survive reopen and export but are not written as `/Outlines`; other readers see the original outline only.
- **Letter has no Blank recipe** in the migrated data; `?new=Letter` resolves to a ruled or squared Letter sheet.
- **Print uses the DOM print pipeline**, so hidden PDF canvas fragments that have not painted print blank; pages are rasterised at a 2× floor to keep them sharp.
- **Crop handles assume an unrotated viewer.** 0°/180° are exact; 90°/270° use the rotated screen box and can feel slightly off at high zoom.
- **Snapshot capture is best-effort** for PDF pages that have not painted yet.
- **Desktop windows are Chromium** (WebView2 for Tauri, Edge/Chrome for the launcher); Safari/Firefox are untested.
- **Stamp catalogue is one ~569 kB chunk** (59 kB gzip); the Vite warning limit is raised to 600 kB rather than lazy-loading synchronous stamp lookup everywhere.

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { CommandPalette } from "./components/CommandPalette";
import { FavoriteToolsBar } from "./components/FavoriteToolsBar";
import { Inspector } from "./components/Inspector";
import { NewDocumentModal } from "./components/NewDocumentModal";
import { SearchBar } from "./components/SearchBar";
import { SettingsModal } from "./components/SettingsModal";
import { PaperViewport } from "./components/canvas/PaperViewport";
import { PresentationBar } from "./components/PresentationBar";
import { Sidebar } from "./components/Sidebar";
import { StampLibrary } from "./components/StampLibrary";
import { ToolBar } from "./components/ToolBar";
import { TopBar } from "./components/TopBar";
import { addImageStamp } from "./lib/images";
import { parseBootArgs, resolvePaperTarget } from "./lib/bootArgs";
import { paperTemplates } from "./lib/data";
import { loadMirroredStamps, useCustomStampStore } from "./lib/customStamps";
import { readImageFile } from "./lib/raster";
import { saveActiveDocument } from "./lib/save";
import { bindingFromEvent, normalizeBinding, useShortcutStore } from "./lib/shortcuts";
import { loadWorkspace, saveWorkspace } from "./lib/storage";
import { TOOL_BY_ID } from "./lib/tools";
import type { ToolId } from "./lib/types";
import { useAnnotationStore } from "./stores/useAnnotationStore";
import { useDocStore } from "./stores/useDocStore";
import { useToolStore } from "./stores/useToolStore";
import { useUIStore } from "./stores/useUIStore";

function isTyping(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  return (
    target instanceof HTMLElement &&
    (target.tagName === "INPUT" ||
      target.tagName === "TEXTAREA" ||
      target.tagName === "SELECT" ||
      target.isContentEditable)
  );
}

/**
 * A `.pdf` opened from Windows Explorer reaches the Rust shell as a positional
 * argument; it reads the file once and this bridge turns it into a tab.
 */
async function openStartupPdf(): Promise<void> {
  const bridge = (window as unknown as {
    __TAURI_INTERNALS__?: { invoke?: (command: string) => Promise<unknown> };
  }).__TAURI_INTERNALS__;
  if (!bridge?.invoke) return;
  try {
    const pdf = (await bridge.invoke("get_startup_pdf")) as { name: string; base64: string } | null;
    if (!pdf?.base64) return;
    const binary = atob(pdf.base64);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for (let index = 0; index < binary.length; index += 1) bytes[index] = binary.charCodeAt(index);
    await useDocStore.getState().openPdfBytes(bytes, pdf.name);
  } catch {
    // No document was requested, or this is not the desktop shell.
  }
}

export default function App() {
  const presentation = useUIStore((state) => state.presentation);
  const setPresentation = useUIStore((state) => state.setPresentation);
  const setPaletteOpen = useUIStore((state) => state.setPaletteOpen);
  const toast = useUIStore((state) => state.toast);
  const toastAction = useUIStore((state) => state.toastAction);
  const setTool = useToolStore((state) => state.setTool);
  const zoomBy = useDocStore((state) => state.zoomBy);
  const setFit = useDocStore((state) => state.setFit);
  const setPage = useDocStore((state) => state.setPage);
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const ready = useRef(false);
  const saveFailed = useRef(false);

  // Restore the last workspace, then autosave every change to IndexedDB.
  useEffect(() => {
    const boot = parseBootArgs(typeof window === "undefined" ? "" : window.location.search);
    void loadWorkspace().then((saved) => {
      if (saved) useDocStore.getState().restore(saved.tabs, saved.activeId);
      // The IndexedDB mirror survives a cleared localStorage.
      void loadMirroredStamps().then((mirrored) => {
        if (mirrored) useCustomStampStore.getState().restore(mirrored);
      });
      ready.current = true;
      // Desktop launch contract: a requested paper size, presentation, or print run.
      if (boot.newDoc) {
        const target = resolvePaperTarget(boot.newDoc, paperTemplates);
        if (target) useDocStore.getState().newTab(target.templateId, boot.newDoc.trim(), target.landscape);
      }
      if (boot.fullscreen) useUIStore.getState().setPresentation(true);
      if (boot.print) window.setTimeout(() => window.print(), 500);
      // After the workspace restore, so a file opened from Explorer becomes the active tab.
      void openStartupPdf();
    });
    let timer = 0;
    let pending: { tabs: import("./lib/types").DocumentTab[]; activeId: string } | null = null;
    // Structural changes only: zoom, page and tool updates do not touch `tabs`.
    let lastTabs = useDocStore.getState().tabs;
    let lastActiveId = useDocStore.getState().activeId;
    const flush = () => {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      timer = 0;
      const value = pending;
      pending = null;
      if (!value) return;
      void saveWorkspace(value.tabs, value.activeId).then((ok) => {
        if (ok || saveFailed.current) return;
        saveFailed.current = true;
        useUIStore.getState().setToast("Workspace autosave failed — storage may be full. Export a backup from Settings.");
      });
    };
    const unsubscribe = useDocStore.subscribe((state) => {
      if (!ready.current) return;
      if (state.tabs === lastTabs && state.activeId === lastActiveId) return;
      lastTabs = state.tabs;
      lastActiveId = state.activeId;
      pending = { tabs: state.tabs, activeId: state.activeId };
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      timer = window.setTimeout(flush, 1000);
    });
    // A hidden page or a closed window must not lose the last second of edits.
    const onVisibility = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") flush();
    };
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
    window.addEventListener("pagehide", flush);
    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
      window.removeEventListener("pagehide", flush);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!toast) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => useUIStore.getState().setToast(null), 3400);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [toast]);

  // An unpinned tool popover collapses as soon as the next stroke starts.
  useEffect(() => {
    const onStrokeBegin = () => {
      const ui = useUIStore.getState();
      if (!ui.toolPopoverPinned) ui.closeToolPopover();
    };
    window.addEventListener("pm:stroke-begin", onStrokeBegin);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("pm:stroke-begin", onStrokeBegin);
  }, []);

  // Images arrive through the clipboard as files, not annotations.
  useEffect(() => {
    const onPaste = (event: ClipboardEvent) => {
      if (isTyping(event.target)) return;
      const items = [...(event.clipboardData?.items ?? [])];
      const item = items.find((entry) => entry.type.startsWith("image/"));
      const file = item?.getAsFile();
      if (!file) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      void readImageFile(file)
        .then((image) => addImageStamp(image))
        .catch(() => useUIStore.getState().setToast("That clipboard image could not be read"));
    };
    window.addEventListener("paste", onPaste);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("paste", onPaste);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (isTyping(event.target)) return;
      const annotations = useAnnotationStore.getState();
      const pressed = bindingFromEvent(event);
      const action = pressed ? useShortcutStore.getState().resolve().get(normalizeBinding(pressed)) : undefined;

      switch (action) {
        case "palette":
          event.preventDefault();
          useUIStore.getState().setPaletteOpen(!useUIStore.getState().paletteOpen);
          return;
        case "settings":
          event.preventDefault();
          useUIStore.getState().setSettingsOpen(true);
          return;
        case "presentation":
          event.preventDefault();
          setPresentation(true);
          return;
        case "open":
          event.preventDefault();
          fileRef.current?.click();
          return;
        case "save":
          event.preventDefault();
          void saveActiveDocument("editable");
          return;
        case "print":
          event.preventDefault();
          window.print();
          return;
        case "undo":
          event.preventDefault();
          useDocStore.getState().undo();
          return;
        case "redo":
          event.preventDefault();
          useDocStore.getState().redo();
          return;
        case "copy":
          if (annotations.selection.length === 0) return;
          event.preventDefault();
          annotations.copySelection();
          return;
        case "cut":
          if (annotations.selection.length === 0) return;
          event.preventDefault();
          annotations.cutSelection();
          return;
        case "paste":
          if (annotations.clipboard.length === 0) return;
          event.preventDefault();
          annotations.paste();
          return;
        case "duplicate":
          event.preventDefault();
          annotations.duplicateSelection();
          return;
        case "select-all": {
          event.preventDefault();
          const state = useDocStore.getState();
          const tab = state.tabs.find((item) => item.id === state.activeId);
          const page = tab?.pages[state.page - 1];
          if (page) {
            annotations.select(
              page.annotations.filter((annotation) => !annotation.hidden && !annotation.locked).map((annotation) => annotation.id),
            );
          }
          return;
        }
        case "group":
          event.preventDefault();
          annotations.groupSelection();
          return;
        case "ungroup":
          event.preventDefault();
          annotations.ungroupSelection();
          return;
        case "search":
          event.preventDefault();
          useUIStore.getState().setSearchOpen(true);
          return;
        case "view-one-page":
          event.preventDefault();
          useUIStore.getState().setViewMode("one-page");
          return;
        case "view-one-continuous":
          event.preventDefault();
          useUIStore.getState().setViewMode("one-continuous");
          return;
        case "view-two-continuous":
          event.preventDefault();
          useUIStore.getState().setViewMode("two-continuous");
          return;
        case "view-two-page":
          event.preventDefault();
          useUIStore.getState().setViewMode("two-page");
          return;
        case "toggle-cover-page":
          event.preventDefault();
          useUIStore.getState().toggleSeparateCoverPage();
          return;
      }

      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        const ui = useUIStore.getState();
        if (ui.searchOpen) ui.setSearchOpen(false);
        else if (ui.paletteOpen) ui.setPaletteOpen(false);
        else if (ui.libraryOpen) ui.setLibraryOpen(false);
        else if (ui.settingsOpen) ui.setSettingsOpen(false);
        else if (ui.newDocOpen) ui.setNewDocOpen(false);
        else if (ui.toolPopoverOpen) ui.closeToolPopover();
        else if (ui.sidebarOpen) ui.toggleSidebar();
        else if (ui.presentation) setPresentation(false);
        else useAnnotationStore.getState().clearSelection();
        return;
      }

      if (event.key === "Delete" || event.key === "Backspace") {
        if (annotations.selection.length === 0) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        annotations.deleteSelection();
        return;
      }

      if (event.key.startsWith("Arrow")) {
        if (annotations.selection.length === 0) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        const step = event.shiftKey ? 5 : 1;
        const dx = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
        const dy = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
        annotations.nudge(dx, dy);
        return;
      }

      if (action === "fit-page") {
        setFit("page");
        return;
      }
      if (action && TOOL_BY_ID.has(action as ToolId)) {
        setTool(action as ToolId);
        return;
      }

      if (event.altKey) return;

      if (event.code === "Equal" || event.code === "NumpadAdd" || event.key === "+") {
        zoomBy(1);
        return;
      }
      if (event.code === "Minus" || event.code === "NumpadSubtract" || event.key === "-") {
        zoomBy(-1);
        return;
      }
      if (event.key === "PageDown" || event.key === "PageUp") {
        event.preventDefault();
        setPage(useDocStore.getState().page + (event.key === "PageDown" ? 1 : -1));
        return;
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [setFit, setPage, setPaletteOpen, setPresentation, setTool, zoomBy]);

  return (
    <div className="app-bg flex h-full flex-col overflow-hidden">
      <input
        ref={fileRef}
        id="pm-pdf-input"
        type="file"
        accept="application/pdf,.pdf"
        className="hidden"
        onChange={(event) => {
          const file = event.target.files?.[0];
          if (file) void useDocStore.getState().openPdfFile(file);
          event.target.value = "";
        }}
      />
      {presentation ? (
        <div className="relative h-full w-full overflow-hidden">
          <PaperViewport />
          <PresentationBar />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <TopBar />
          <div className="relative flex min-h-0 flex-1">
            <Sidebar />
            <FavoriteToolsBar />
            <main className="relative min-w-0 flex-1">
              <PaperViewport />
              <ToolBar />
              <Inspector />
            </main>
            <SearchBar />
          </div>
          <CommandPalette />
          <StampLibrary />
          <NewDocumentModal />
          <SettingsModal />
        </>
      )}
      {toast && (
        <div className={`fixed bottom-5 left-1/2 z-[60] -translate-x-1/2 ${toastAction ? "pointer-events-auto" : "pointer-events-none"}`}>
          <div className="glass-strong flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-[11.5px] shadow-lg">
            <span>{toast}</span>
            {toastAction && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="chip h-6 px-2"
                onClick={() => {
                  toastAction();
                  useUIStore.getState().setToast(null);
                }}
              >
                Undo
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Command, FileText, Printer, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { paperTemplates } from "../lib/data";
import { TOOLS } from "../lib/tools";
import type { ToolId } from "../lib/types";
import { useDocStore } from "../stores/useDocStore";
import { useToolStore } from "../stores/useToolStore";
import { useUIStore } from "../stores/useUIStore";
import { TOOL_ICONS, type IconComponent } from "./toolIcons";

interface CommandItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  hint: string;
  group: "Tools" | "Actions" | "Paper";
  Icon: IconComponent;
  run: () => void;
}

export function CommandPalette() {
  const open = useUIStore((state) => state.paletteOpen);
  const setPaletteOpen = useUIStore((state) => state.setPaletteOpen);
  const setTheme = useUIStore((state) => state.setTheme);
  const setNewDocOpen = useUIStore((state) => state.setNewDocOpen);
  const setLibraryOpen = useUIStore((state) => state.setLibraryOpen);
  const toggleSidebar = useUIStore((state) => state.toggleSidebar);
  const setPresentation = useUIStore((state) => state.setPresentation);
  const setSettingsOpen = useUIStore((state) => state.setSettingsOpen);
  const setTool = useToolStore((state) => state.setTool);
  const newTab = useDocStore((state) => state.newTab);
  const setFit = useDocStore((state) => state.setFit);
  const setZoom = useDocStore((state) => state.setZoom);

  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const items = useMemo<CommandItem[]>(() => {
    const close = () => setPaletteOpen(false);
    const toolItems = TOOLS.map((tool) => ({
      id: `tool-${tool.id}`,
      label: tool.name,
      hint: tool.shortcut,
      group: "Tools" as const,
      Icon: TOOL_ICONS[tool.id],
      run: () => {
        setTool(tool.id as ToolId);
        close();
      },
    }));
    const actions: CommandItem[] = [
      {
        id: "new-document",
        label: "New document…",
        hint: "129 paper recipes",
        group: "Actions",
        Icon: FileText,
        run: () => {
          setNewDocOpen(true);
          close();
        },
      },
      {
        id: "stamp-library",
        label: "Open stamp library",
        hint: "Factory and own stamps",
        group: "Actions",
        Icon: TOOL_ICONS.stamp,
        run: () => {
          setLibraryOpen(true);
          close();
        },
      },
      {
        id: "settings",
        label: "Open settings",
        hint: "Shortcuts, preferences",
        group: "Actions",
        Icon: Command,
        run: () => {
          setSettingsOpen(true);
          close();
        },
      },
      {
        id: "print",
        label: "Print current page",
        hint: "Ctrl+P",
        group: "Actions",
        Icon: Printer,
        run: () => {
          close();
          window.print();
        },
      },
      {
        id: "fit-page",
        label: "Fit page",
        hint: "Zoom",
        group: "Actions",
        Icon: Command,
        run: () => {
          setFit("page");
          close();
        },
      },
      {
        id: "fit-width",
        label: "Fit width",
        hint: "Zoom",
        group: "Actions",
        Icon: Command,
        run: () => {
          setFit("width");
          close();
        },
      },
      {
        id: "zoom-100",
        label: "Zoom to 100 %",
        hint: "⌘0",
        group: "Actions",
        Icon: Command,
        run: () => {
          setZoom(1);
          close();
        },
      },
      {
        id: "toggle-sidebar",
        label: "Toggle sidebar",
        hint: "Panels",
        group: "Actions",
        Icon: FileText,
        run: () => {
          toggleSidebar();
          close();
        },
      },
      {
        id: "presentation",
        label: "Enter presentation mode",
        hint: "Full screen canvas",
        group: "Actions",
        Icon: Command,
        run: () => {
          setPresentation(true);
          close();
        },
      },
      { id: "theme-light", label: "Theme: Apple Light", hint: "Appearance", group: "Actions", Icon: Command, run: () => { setTheme("light"); close(); } },
      { id: "theme-dark", label: "Theme: Apple Dark", hint: "Appearance", group: "Actions", Icon: Command, run: () => { setTheme("dark"); close(); } },
      { id: "theme-sepia", label: "Theme: Sepia", hint: "Appearance", group: "Actions", Icon: Command, run: () => { setTheme("sepia"); close(); } },
    ];
    const paperItems: CommandItem[] = paperTemplates.map((template) => ({
      id: `paper-${template.id}`,
      label: template.name,
      hint: `${template.styleLabel} · ${template.detail || template.page.size}`,
      group: "Paper",
      Icon: FileText,
      run: () => {
        newTab(template.id, template.name);
        close();
      },
    }));
    return [...toolItems, ...actions, ...paperItems];
  }, [newTab, setFit, setLibraryOpen, setNewDocOpen, setPaletteOpen, setPresentation, setSettingsOpen, setTheme, setTool, setZoom, toggleSidebar]);

  const results = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matches = needle
      ? items.filter((item) => `${item.label} ${item.hint}`.toLowerCase().includes(needle))
      : items.filter((item) => item.group !== "Paper").concat(items.filter((item) => item.group === "Paper").slice(0, 6));
    return matches.slice(0, 60);
  }, [items, query]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    setQuery("");
    setIndex(0);
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 20);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIndex(0);
  }, [query]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const run = (item: CommandItem | undefined) => {
    if (!item) return;
    item.run();
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex justify-center bg-black/25 px-4 pt-[10vh] backdrop-blur-[3px]"
      onPointerDown={(event) => {
        if (event.target === event.currentTarget) setPaletteOpen(false);
      }}
    >
      <div
        className="glass-strong anim-in flex max-h-[70vh] w-full max-w-[580px] flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label="Command palette"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 border-b border-[var(--border)] px-3.5 py-3">
          <Search size={16} strokeWidth={1.75} className="text-muted" />
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            className="flex-1 border-0 bg-transparent text-[13.5px] outline-none placeholder:text-muted"
            placeholder="Search tools, stamps, paper and actions…"
            value={query}
            onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (event.key === "ArrowDown") {
                event.preventDefault();
                setIndex((current) => Math.min(results.length - 1, current + 1));
              } else if (event.key === "ArrowUp") {
                event.preventDefault();
                setIndex((current) => Math.max(0, current - 1));
              } else if (event.key === "Enter") {
                event.preventDefault();
                run(results[index]);
              } else if (event.key === "Escape") {
                event.preventDefault();
                setPaletteOpen(false);
              }
            }}
            aria-label="Command search"
          />
          <kbd className="rounded border border-[var(--border)] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9.5px] text-muted">Esc</kbd>
        </div>

        <div className="scroll-thin min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-1.5">
          {results.length === 0 && (
            <p className="px-3 py-8 text-center text-[12px] text-muted">Nothing matches “{query}”.</p>
          )}
          {results.map((item, itemIndex) => {
            const showGroup = itemIndex === 0 || results[itemIndex - 1].group !== item.group;
            const Icon = item.Icon;
            return (
              <div key={item.id}>
                {showGroup && (
                  <div className="px-2.5 pb-1 pt-2 text-[9.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-muted">
                    {item.group}
                  </div>
                )}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left"
                  style={itemIndex === index ? { background: "var(--accent-soft)", color: "var(--accent)" } : undefined}
                  onPointerEnter={() => setIndex(itemIndex)}
                  onClick={() => run(item)}
                >
                  <Icon size={15} strokeWidth={1.75} />
                  <span className="flex-1 truncate text-[12.5px]">{item.label}</span>
                  <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-muted">{item.hint}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-t border-[var(--border)] px-3.5 py-2 text-[10px] text-muted">
          <span>↑↓ navigate</span>
          <span>↵ open</span>
          <span className="ml-auto">{items.length} commands</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Pencil, X } from "lucide-react";
import { penStyleOptions, inkPath } from "../lib/ink";
import type { InkPoint } from "../lib/annotationTypes";
import { useFavoritesStore, type FavoriteTool } from "../stores/useFavoritesStore";
import { useToolStore } from "../stores/useToolStore";
import { useUIStore } from "../stores/useUIStore";
import { TOOL_ICONS } from "./toolIcons";

/** A small ink swatch that shows the saved colour, nib and stroke style. */
function FavoriteGlyph({ item }: { item: FavoriteTool }) {
  const color = item.props.color ?? "#101114";
  const style = item.penStyle ?? item.props.penStyle ?? "pro";
  const level = item.props.pressureLevel ?? 55;
  // Capped so a 16 mm nib still reads as a delicate wave inside a 28 px icon.
  const nib = Math.max(1.4, Math.min(3, 1.4 + Math.sqrt(item.props.thicknessMm ?? 1) * 0.4));
  const opacity = item.props.opacity ?? 1;

  const wave = useMemo(() => {
    const points: InkPoint[] = [];
    for (let index = 0; index <= 24; index += 1) {
      const t = index / 24;
      points.push([3 + t * 26, 14 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 2) * 6, 0.35 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 3) * 0.5 + 0.5]);
    }
    return inkPath(points, nib, { ...penStyleOptions(style, level), simulatePressure: false });
  }, [level, nib, style]);

  if (item.tool === "pen" || item.tool === "formula") {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 32 28" className="h-7 w-7" aria-hidden="true">
        <path d={wave} fill={color} opacity={opacity} />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  if (item.tool === "marker") {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 32 28" className="h-7 w-7" aria-hidden="true">
        <circle cx="16" cy="14" r="9" fill={color} opacity={0.28} />
        <circle cx="16" cy="14" r="6" fill={color} opacity={Math.min(1, opacity + 0.35)} />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  if (item.tool === "text") {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 32 28" className="h-7 w-7" aria-hidden="true">
        <text x="16" y="21" textAnchor="middle" fontFamily="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif" fontSize="18" fill={color}>
          T
        </text>
      </svg>
    );
  }
  if (item.tool === "line") {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 32 28" className="h-7 w-7" aria-hidden="true">
        <line x1="6" y1="22" x2="26" y2="7" stroke={color} strokeWidth={nib} strokeLinecap="round" />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  if (item.tool === "arrow") {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 32 28" className="h-7 w-7" aria-hidden="true">
        <line x1="5" y1="14" x2="24" y2="14" stroke={color} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
        <path d="M20 9l7 5-7 5z" fill={color} />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  const Icon = TOOL_ICONS[item.tool];
  return <Icon size={18} strokeWidth={1.75} />;
}

export function FavoriteToolsBar() {
  const open = useUIStore((state) => state.favoritesOpen);
  const sidebarOpen = useUIStore((state) => state.sidebarOpen);
  const favorites = useFavoritesStore((state) => state.favorites);
  const remove = useFavoritesStore((state) => state.remove);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);

  if (!open) return null;

  const activate = (item: FavoriteTool) => {
    const tools = useToolStore.getState();
    tools.setTool(item.tool);
    tools.setProps({ ...item.props, ...(item.penStyle ? { penStyle: item.penStyle } : {}) });
    useUIStore.getState().openToolPopover();
  };

  return (
    <div className="favorite-dock absolute top-1/2 z-30 -translate-y-1/2" style={{ left: sidebarOpen ? 348 : 68 }}>
      <div className="glass no-scrollbar flex max-h-[calc(100vh-140px)] w-11 flex-col items-center gap-1 overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto rounded-full px-0 py-1.5">
        {favorites.map((item) => (
          <div key={item.id} className="tooltip relative">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-full border border-transparent transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--hover)]"
              aria-label={item.label}
              title={item.label}
              onContextMenu={(event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                remove(item.id);
              }}
              onClick={() => activate(item)}
            >
              <FavoriteGlyph item={item} />
            </button>
            {editing && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="absolute -right-0.5 -top-0.5 grid h-4 w-4 place-items-center rounded-full"
                style={{ background: "var(--danger)", color: "#fff" }}
                aria-label={`Remove ${item.label}`}
                onClick={(event) => {
                  event.stopPropagation();
                  remove(item.id);
                }}
              >
                <X size={9} strokeWidth={2.5} />
              </button>
            )}
            <span className="tooltip-body">{item.label}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div className="my-0.5 h-px w-5 bg-[var(--border)]" />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="icon-btn h-7 w-7"
          aria-label={editing ? "Finish editing favourites" : "Edit favourites"}
          aria-pressed={editing}
          title={editing ? "Done" : "Edit favourites"}
          onClick={() => setEditing((value) => !value)}
        >
          <Pencil size={12} strokeWidth={1.75} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const ALIGNMENTS: { mode: AlignMode; label: string; Icon: typeof AlignStartVertical }[] = [
  { mode: "left", label: "Align left", Icon: AlignStartVertical },
  { mode: "center", label: "Align centre", Icon: AlignCenterVertical },
  { mode: "right", label: "Align right", Icon: AlignEndVertical },
  { mode: "top", label: "Align top", Icon: AlignStartHorizontal },
  { mode: "middle", label: "Align middle", Icon: AlignCenterHorizontal },
  { mode: "bottom", label: "Align bottom", Icon: AlignEndHorizontal },
];

function firstValue<T>(annotations: Annotation[], pick: (annotation: Annotation) => T | undefined): T | undefined {
  for (const annotation of annotations) {
    const value = pick(annotation);
    if (value !== undefined) return value;
  }
  return undefined;
}

function MeasureInspector({ pageWidthMm }: { pageWidthMm: number }) {
  const measureMode = useUIStore((state) => state.measureMode);
  const setMeasureMode = useUIStore((state) => state.setMeasureMode);
  const measureUnit = usePrefsStore((state) => state.measureUnit);
  const setPrefs = usePrefsStore((state) => state.set);
  const custom = useScaleStore((state) => state.custom);
  const activeId = useScaleStore((state) => state.activeId);
  const setActive = useScaleStore((state) => state.setActive);
  const addCustom = useScaleStore((state) => state.addCustom);
  const [pageLength, setPageLength] = useState(() => Number(pageWidthMm.toFixed(1)));
  const [realLength, setRealLength] = useState(210);

  const denominator = calibrateDenominator(pageLength, realLength, measureUnit);
  const scales = [...PRESET_SCALES, ...custom];

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-[var(--border)] p-2.5">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] font-medium">
        <Ruler size={14} /> Measure
      </div>
      <Segmented value={measureMode} options={MEASURE_MODES} onChange={setMeasureMode} />

      <div className="field">
        <span className="field-label">Scale</span>
        <select className="text-input" value={activeId} onChange={(event) => setActive(event.target.value)} aria-label="Measurement scale">
          {scales.map((scale) => (
            <option key={scale.id} value={scale.id}>
              {scale.label}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>

      <div className="field">
        <span className="field-label">Default unit</span>
        <Segmented
          value={measureUnit}
          options={MEASURE_UNITS}
          onChange={(value) => setPrefs({ measureUnit: value })}
        />
      </div>

      <details className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--border)] px-2.5 py-2">
        <summary className="cursor-pointer text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-muted">Calibrate</summary>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 pt-2.5">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
            <label className="field">
              <span className="field-label">On page (mm)</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                step={0.1}
                className="text-input"
                value={pageLength}
                onChange={(event) => setPageLength(Number(event.target.value))}
              />
            </label>
            <label className="field">
              <span className="field-label">Real length ({measureUnit})</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0.1}
                step={0.1}
                className="text-input"
                value={realLength}
                onChange={(event) => setRealLength(Number(event.target.value))}
              />
            </label>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1">
            <button type="button" className="chip h-7 justify-center" onClick={() => setPageLength(Number(pageWidthMm.toFixed(1)))}>
              From page
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="chip h-7 justify-center"
              disabled={!denominator}
              onClick={() => {
                if (!denominator) return;
                addCustom({ id: `custom-${Date.now().toString(36)}`, label: customScaleLabel(denominator), denominator });
              }}
            >
              <Save size={11} /> Save scale
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </details>
    </div>
  );
}
