      boxFillTransparent: toolProps.fill === null,
      frameType: 0,
      frameColor: toolProps.color,
      lineWidthMm: Math.max(0.2, toolProps.thicknessMm),
      autoFit: false,
      rotation: 0,
      opacity: toolProps.opacity,
    };
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    interaction.current = null;
    cancelLongPress();
    setDraft(null);
    setMeasure({ points: [], cursor: null, finished: false });
    setSnap(null);
  }, [activeTool]);

  useEffect(() => cancelLongPress, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMeasure({ points: [], cursor: null, finished: false });
  }, [measureMode]);

  // The toolbar's Image and Formula buttons act immediately, without a canvas click.
  useEffect(() => {
    const pickImage = () => imageInput.current?.click();
    const cancelDraft = () => {
      interaction.current = null;
      setDraft(null);
    };
    const pinchStart = () => {
      pinching.current = true;
      cancelDraft();
    };
    const pinchEnd = () => {
      pinching.current = false;
    };
    const openFormula = () => {
      const toolPropsNow = useToolStore.getState().props.formula ?? useToolStore.getState().props.pen;
      const annotation: FormulaAnnotation = {
        id: makeId("a"),
        type: "formula",
        latex: "E = mc^2",
        xMm: widthMm / 2 - 30,
        yMm: heightMm / 2 - 12,
        widthMm: 60,
        heightMm: 24,
        color: toolPropsNow.color,
        fontSizePt: Math.max(10, toolPropsNow.fontSize || 14),
        fillColor: toolPropsNow.fill ?? "#ffffff",
        fillTransparent: toolPropsNow.fill === null,
        rotation: 0,
        opacity: toolPropsNow.opacity,
      };
      const rect = svgRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
      // Centre the panel on the page, not its top-left corner.
      const center = rect
        ? { x: rect.left + rect.width / 2, y: rect.top + rect.height / 2 }
        : { x: window.innerWidth / 2, y: window.innerHeight / 2 };
      setFormulaEdit({
        annotation,
        anchor: { x: center.x - FORMULA_PANEL.width / 2, y: center.y - FORMULA_PANEL.height / 2 },
      });
    };
    window.addEventListener("pm:pick-image", pickImage);
    window.addEventListener("pm:cancel-draft", cancelDraft);
    window.addEventListener("pm:pinch-start", pinchStart);
    window.addEventListener("pm:pinch-end", pinchEnd);
    window.addEventListener("pm:open-formula", openFormula);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("pm:pick-image", pickImage);
      window.removeEventListener("pm:cancel-draft", cancelDraft);
      window.removeEventListener("pm:pinch-start", pinchStart);
      window.removeEventListener("pm:pinch-end", pinchEnd);
      window.removeEventListener("pm:open-formula", openFormula);
    };
  }, [widthMm, heightMm]);

  const commitInk = (points: InkPoint[], tool: "pen" | "marker", shift: boolean) => {
    if (points.length < 1) return;
    // A tap is a dot: two points give it a visible nib mark.
    let final: InkPoint[] = points.length === 1 ? [points[0], [points[0][0] + 0.01, points[0][1], points[0][2]]] : points;
    if (tool === "marker" && (toolProps.straightHighlight || shift)) {
      const first = final[0];
      const last = final[final.length - 1];
      const angle = Math.abs((Math.atan2(last[1] - first[1], last[0] - first[0]) * 180) / Math.PI);
      const endY = angle <= 4 || angle >= 176 ? first[1] : last[1];
      final = [first, [last[0], endY, last[2]]];
    } else if (shift) {
      const first = final[0];
      const last = final[final.length - 1];
      const snapped = snapAngle([first[0], first[1]], [last[0], last[1]]);
      final = [first, [snapped[0], snapped[1], last[2]]];
    }
    // Only a deliberate, wide, rapidly zig-zagging scribble erases; handwriting never does.
    if (tool === "pen" && usePrefsStore.getState().scratchOut && detectScratchOut(final, { minReversals: 8, minAspect: 3.5 })) {
      const xs = points.map(([x]) => x);
      const ys = points.map(([, y]) => y);
      useAnnotationStore.getState().scratchOut({
        x: Math.min(...xs) - 1,
        y: Math.min(...ys) - 1,
        width: Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs) + 2,
        height: Math.max(...ys) - Math.min(...ys) + 2,
      });
      return;
    }
    const annotation: PenAnnotation | MarkerAnnotation =
      tool === "pen"
        ? {
            id: makeId("a"),
            type: "pen",
            points: final,
            color: toolProps.color,
            thicknessMm: toolProps.thicknessMm,
            opacity: toolProps.opacity,
            sensitivity: toolProps.pressureSensitive,
            smoothed: toolProps.smoothing,
            penStyle: toolProps.penStyle,
            pressureLevel: toolProps.pressureLevel,
          }
        : {
            id: makeId("a"),
            type: "marker",
            points: final,
            color: toolProps.color,
            thicknessMm: toolProps.thicknessMm,
            opacity: toolProps.opacity,
            tipStyle: toolProps.tipStyle ?? "vertical",
          };
    addSilently(annotation);
  };

  const commitShape = (shapeType: ShapeType, start: Pt, end: Pt, points: Pt[] = []) => {
    const polygon = shapeType === "polygon";
    if (polygon ? points.length < 3 : distance(start, end) < 0.4) return;
    const shape = shapeProps(shapeType, start, end);
    shape.points = polygon ? points : [];
    addSilently(shape);
  };

  const polygonSides = () => toolProps.polygonSides ?? 6;

  const commitStamp = (start: Pt, end: Pt) => {
    const art = selectedStampId ? stampArt(selectedStampId) : null;
    if (!art) return;
    const nativeW = art.width / PX_PER_MM;
    const nativeH = art.height / PX_PER_MM;
    const draggedW = Math.abs(end[0] - start[0]);
    const draggedH = Math.abs(end[1] - start[1]);
    const useDrag = draggedW > 1.5 && draggedH > 1.5;
    const widthMm = useDrag ? draggedW : nativeW;
    const heightMm = useDrag ? draggedH : nativeH;
    const xMm = useDrag ? Math.min(start[0], end[0]) : start[0] - widthMm / 2;
    const yMm = useDrag ? Math.min(start[1], end[1]) : start[1] - heightMm / 2;
    const stamp: StampAnnotation = {
      id: makeId("a"),
      type: "stamp",
      stampId: selectedStampId ?? art.name,
      imageUrl: art.imageUrl ?? "",
      xMm,
      yMm,
      widthMm,
      heightMm,
      rotation: 0,
      flipH: false,
      flipV: false,
      opacity: 1,
    };
    addSilently(stamp);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (activeTool === "measure") {
        if (event.key === "Escape") {
          setMeasure({ points: [], cursor: null, finished: false });
          return;
        }
        if (event.key === "Enter" && (measureMode === "perimeter" || measureMode === "area") && measure.points.length >= 2) {
          event.preventDefault();
          setMeasure((current) => ({ ...current, cursor: null, finished: true }));
          return;
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [activeTool, measure, measureMode]);

  const selectAt = (point: Pt, additive: boolean): Annotation | null => {
    const list = page.annotations;
    let hit: Annotation | null = null;
    for (let index = list.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
      const annotation = list[index];
      if (annotation.hidden || annotation.locked) continue;
      if (hitTest(annotation, point)) {
        hit = annotation;
        break;
      }
    }
    const store = useAnnotationStore.getState();
    if (!hit) {
      if (!additive) store.clearSelection();
      return null;
    }
    let ids = [hit.id];
    const groupId = typeof hit.groupId === "string" && hit.groupId.length > 0 ? hit.groupId : null;
    if (groupId) ids = list.filter((annotation) => annotation.groupId === groupId).map((annotation) => annotation.id);
    if (additive) {
      const all = ids.every((id) => store.selection.includes(id));
      store.select(all ? store.selection.filter((id) => !ids.includes(id)) : [...new Set([...store.selection, ...ids])]);
    } else if (!ids.every((id) => store.selection.includes(id))) {
      store.select(ids);
    }
    return hit;
  };

  const selectInBox = (box: BBox, additive: boolean) => {
    const ids = page.annotations
      .filter((annotation) => !annotation.hidden && !annotation.locked)
      .filter((annotation) => {
        const other = annotationBounds(annotation);
        return other.x < box.x + box.width && other.x + other.width > box.x && other.y < box.y + box.height && other.y + other.height > box.y;
      })
      .map((annotation) => annotation.id);
    const store = useAnnotationStore.getState();
    store.select(additive ? [...new Set([...store.selection, ...ids])] : ids);
  };

  const selectInLasso = (polygon: Pt[]) => {
    if (polygon.length < 3) return;
    const ids = page.annotations
      .filter((annotation) => !annotation.hidden && !annotation.locked)
      .filter((annotation) => {
        const center = annotationBounds(annotation);
        const probe: Pt = [center.x + center.width / 2, center.y + center.height / 2];
        return pointInPolygon(probe, polygon) || samplePoints(annotation).some((sample) => pointInPolygon(sample, polygon));
      })
      .map((annotation) => annotation.id);
    useAnnotationStore.getState().select(ids);
  };

  const startSelect = (point: Pt, additive: boolean) => {
    const hit = selectAt(point, additive);
    if (hit) {
      if (useAnnotationStore.getState().selection.includes(hit.id)) {
        interaction.current = { kind: "move", last: point, pushed: false };
      }
      return;
    }
    interaction.current = { kind: "marquee", start: point, additive };
    setDraft({ kind: "marquee", start: point, end: point });
  };

  const onPointerDown = (event: React.PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    if (pinching.current) return;
    // Stylus erasers report button 5 / bit 32 and must erase whatever tool is active.
    const hardwareErase =
      (event.pointerType as string) === "eraser" || (event.pointerType === "pen" && (event.button === 5 || (event.buttons & 32) !== 0));
    // Hand tool and space-pan still give way to a hardware eraser.
    if (panMode) {
      if (!hardwareErase) return;
      event.stopPropagation();
    }
    // A finger bubbles to the viewport's own pan gesture; pen and mouse always draw.
    if (!drawsWithPointer(event.pointerType, !touchScroll)) return;
    if (!hardwareErase && event.button !== 0) return;
    // Unpinned tool popovers make way for the stroke they would cover.
    if (activeTool !== "hand" && activeTool !== "select") window.dispatchEvent(new Event("pm:stroke-begin"));
    const point = toMm(event.clientX, event.clientY);
    const target = event.currentTarget;
    const begin = (next: Interaction | null) => {
      if (next) interaction.current = next;
      target.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    };

    // Hold still on an annotation to select it, whatever drawing tool is active.
    if (!hardwareErase && LONG_PRESS_TOOLS.includes(activeTool)) {
      cancelLongPress();
      const press = {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY,
        point,
        timer: window.setTimeout(() => {
          longPress.current = null;
          if (!selectAt(press.point, false)) return;
          interaction.current = null;
          setDraft(null);
        }, LONG_PRESS_MS),
      };
      longPress.current = press;
    }

    if (hardwareErase) {
      const split = eraserSplit || event.altKey;
      const pushed = useAnnotationStore.getState().eraseAt(point, split, eraserSizeMm);
      begin({ kind: "erase", last: point, split, pushed });
      return;
    }

    switch (activeTool) {
      case "pen":
      case "marker": {
        const ink: InkPoint = [
          point[0],
          point[1],
          toolProps.pressureSensitive ? pointerPressure(event.pointerType, event.pressure, null, point, 0) : 0.5,
        ];
        begin({ kind: "ink", points: [ink], tool: activeTool, start: point, last: point, lastTime: event.timeStamp });
        setDraft({ kind: "ink", points: [ink], tool: activeTool });
        return;
      }
      case "line":
      case "arrow":
      case "rectangle":
      case "ellipse":
      case "polygon":
      case "dimension": {
        begin({ kind: "shape", start: point, tool: activeTool });
        setDraft({ kind: "shape", shape: shapeProps(activeTool, point, point) });
        return;
      }
      case "stamp": {
        begin({ kind: "stamp", start: point });
        const art = selectedStampId ? stampArt(selectedStampId) : null;
        const nativeW = art ? art.width / PX_PER_MM : 10;
        const nativeH = art ? art.height / PX_PER_MM : 10;
        setDraft({ kind: "stamp", start: point, end: point, widthMm: nativeW, heightMm: nativeH });
        return;
      }
      case "eraser": {
        const split = eraserSplit || event.altKey;
        const pushed = useAnnotationStore.getState().eraseAt(point, split, eraserSizeMm);
        begin({ kind: "erase", last: point, split, pushed });
        return;
      }
      case "select": {
        startSelect(point, event.shiftKey);
        begin(interaction.current);
        return;
      }
      case "lasso": {
        begin({ kind: "lasso", points: [point] });
        setDraft({ kind: "lasso", points: [point] });
        return;
      }
      case "text": {
        begin({ kind: "text", start: point });
        setDraft({ kind: "text", start: point, end: point });
        return;
      }
      case "formula": {
        const annotation: FormulaAnnotation = {
          id: makeId("a"),
          type: "formula",
          latex: "E = mc^2",
          xMm: point[0],
          yMm: point[1],
          widthMm: 60,
          heightMm: 24,
          color: toolProps.color,
          fontSizePt: Math.max(10, toolProps.fontSize || 14),
          fillColor: toolProps.fill ?? "#ffffff",
          fillTransparent: toolProps.fill === null,
          rotation: 0,
          opacity: toolProps.opacity,
        };
        setFormulaEdit({ annotation, anchor: { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY } });
        return;
      }
      case "measure": {
        if (measure.finished) {
          setMeasure({ points: [point], cursor: measureMode === "distance" ? point : null, finished: false });
          if (measureMode === "distance") begin({ kind: "measure", start: point });
          return;
        }
        if (measureMode === "distance") {
          begin({ kind: "measure", start: point });
          setMeasure({ points: [point], cursor: point, finished: false });
          return;
        }
        if (measureMode === "angle") {
          const points = [...measure.points, point].slice(0, 3);
          setMeasure({ points, cursor: null, finished: points.length === 3 });
          return;
        }
        setMeasure({ points: [...measure.points, point], cursor: null, finished: false });
        return;
      }
      case "snapshot": {
        begin({ kind: "snapshot", start: point });
        setSnap(null);
        setDraft({ kind: "snapshot", start: point, end: point });
        return;
      }
      case "image": {
        imagePoint.current = point;
        imageInput.current?.click();
        return;
      }
      default:
        return;
    }
  };

  const onPointerMove = (event: React.PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    if (pinching.current) return;
    if (longPress.current && Math.hypot(event.clientX - longPress.current.x, event.clientY - longPress.current.y) > LONG_PRESS_TOLERANCE_PX) {
      cancelLongPress();
    }
    const current = interaction.current;
    if (activeTool === "measure" && !measure.finished) {
      const point = toMm(event.clientX, event.clientY);
      if (current?.kind === "measure" || measure.points.length > 0) {
        setMeasure((state) => (state.finished ? state : { ...state, cursor: point }));
      }
    }
    if (!current) return;
    const point = toMm(event.clientX, event.clientY);

    if (current.kind === "ink") {
      if (distance(point, current.last) < 0.12) return;
      const pressure = toolProps.pressureSensitive
        ? pointerPressure(event.pointerType, event.pressure, current.last, point, event.timeStamp - current.lastTime)
        : 0.5;
      const first = current.points[0];
      let points = [...current.points, [point[0], point[1], pressure] as InkPoint];
      if (current.tool === "marker" && (toolProps.straightHighlight || event.shiftKey)) {
        points = [first, [point[0], point[1], pressure]];
      } else if (event.shiftKey) {
        const snapped = snapAngle([first[0], first[1]], point);
        points = [first, [snapped[0], snapped[1], pressure]];
      }
      current.points = points;
      current.last = point;
      current.lastTime = event.timeStamp;
      setDraft({ kind: "ink", points, tool: current.tool });
      return;
    }
    if (current.kind === "shape") {
      const boxy = current.tool === "rectangle" || current.tool === "ellipse" || current.tool === "polygon";
      const end = constrainEnd(current.start, point, event.shiftKey, event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey, boxy);
      const shape = shapeProps(current.tool, current.start, end);
      if (current.tool === "polygon") shape.points = regularPolygonPoints(current.start, end, polygonSides());
      setDraft({ kind: "shape", shape });
      return;
    }
    if (current.kind === "stamp") {
      setDraft((previous) => (previous?.kind === "stamp" ? { ...previous, end: point } : previous));
      return;
    }
    if (current.kind === "text") {
      setDraft({ kind: "text", start: current.start, end: point });
      return;
    }
    if (current.kind === "snapshot") {
      setDraft({ kind: "snapshot", start: current.start, end: point });
      return;
    }
    if (current.kind === "erase") {
      if (distance(point, current.last) < 0.8) return;
      current.last = point;
      // One history entry per gesture: eraseAt only snapshots once something actually changes.
      const changed = useAnnotationStore.getState().eraseAt(point, current.split, eraserSizeMm, !current.pushed);
      if (changed) current.pushed = true;
      return;
    }
    if (current.kind === "marquee") {
      setDraft((previous) =>
        previous?.kind === "marquee" ? { ...previous, end: point } : { kind: "marquee", start: current.start, end: point },
      );
      return;
    }
    if (current.kind === "lasso") {
      if (distance(point, current.points[current.points.length - 1]) < 0.4) return;
      current.points = [...current.points, point];
      setDraft({ kind: "lasso", points: current.points });
      return;
    }
    if (current.kind === "move") {
      const dx = point[0] - current.last[0];
      const dy = point[1] - current.last[1];
      if (!current.pushed) {
        useDocStore.getState().pushHistory(tab.id);
        current.pushed = true;
      }
      useAnnotationStore.getState().transform((annotation) => translateAnnotation(annotation, dx, dy));
      current.last = point;
      return;
    }
    if (current.kind === "scale") {
      const { box, handle } = current;
      const handles = handlePoints(box, 0);
      const opposite: Record<HandleId, HandleId> = {
        nw: "se", n: "s", ne: "sw", e: "w", se: "nw", s: "n", sw: "ne", w: "e", rotate: "se",
      };
      const anchor = handles[opposite[handle]];
      const grip = handles[handle];
      const horizontal = handle !== "n" && handle !== "s";
      const vertical = handle !== "e" && handle !== "w";
      let sx = horizontal ? (point[0] - anchor[0]) / (grip[0] - anchor[0]) : 1;
      let sy = vertical ? (point[1] - anchor[1]) / (grip[1] - anchor[1]) : 1;
      if (!Number.isFinite(sx) || Math.abs(sx) < 0.02) sx = 0.02;
      if (!Number.isFinite(sy) || Math.abs(sy) < 0.02) sy = 0.02;
      sx = Math.max(0.02, sx);
      sy = Math.max(0.02, sy);
      if ((event.shiftKey || event.ctrlKey) && horizontal && vertical) {
        const factor = Math.max(sx, sy);
        sx = factor;
        sy = factor;
      }
      if (!current.pushed && (Math.abs(sx - 1) > 0.001 || Math.abs(sy - 1) > 0.001)) {
        useDocStore.getState().pushHistory(tab.id);
        current.pushed = true;
      }
      const initial = new Map(current.initial.map((annotation) => [annotation.id, annotation]));
      useAnnotationStore.getState().mutate(
        (annotations) =>
          annotations.map((annotation) => {
            const base = initial.get(annotation.id);
            return base ? scaleAnnotation(base, anchor, sx, sy) : annotation;
          }),
        false,
      );
      return;
    }
    if (current.kind === "rotate") {
      const angle = (Math.atan2(point[1] - current.center[1], point[0] - current.center[0]) * 180) / Math.PI;
      let delta = angle - current.startAngle;
      if (event.shiftKey) delta = Math.round(delta / 15) * 15;
      if (!current.pushed && Math.abs(delta) > 0.01) {
        useDocStore.getState().pushHistory(tab.id);
        current.pushed = true;
      }
      const initial = current.initial;
      useAnnotationStore.getState().mutate(
        (annotations) => {
          const map = new Map(initial.map((annotation) => [annotation.id, annotation]));
          return annotations.map((annotation) => {
            const base = map.get(annotation.id);
            return base ? rotateAnnotation(base, current.center, delta) : annotation;
          });
        },
        false,
      );
    }
  };

  const capture = async (region: BBox, status: string | null = null) => {
    const pageElement = svgRef.current?.parentElement ?? null;
    const image = await captureRegion(pageElement, region, snapshotDpi);
    setSnap({ region, image, status });
    return image;
  };

  const onPointerUp = (event: React.PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    cancelLongPress();
    const current = interaction.current;
    interaction.current = null;
    if (event.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    if (!current) {
      setDraft(null);
      return;
    }
    const point = toMm(event.clientX, event.clientY);
    if (current.kind === "ink") commitInk(current.points, current.tool, event.shiftKey);
    if (current.kind === "shape") {
      const boxy = current.tool === "rectangle" || current.tool === "ellipse" || current.tool === "polygon";
      const end = constrainEnd(current.start, point, event.shiftKey, event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey, boxy);
      if (current.tool === "polygon") {
        const points = distance(current.start, end) < 0.4 ? [] : regularPolygonPoints(current.start, end, polygonSides());
        commitShape("polygon", current.start, end, points);
      } else {
        commitShape(current.tool, current.start, end);
      }
    }
    if (current.kind === "stamp") commitStamp(current.start, point);
    if (current.kind === "text") {
      setTextEdit({ draft: defaultText(current.start, point), isNew: true });
    }
    if (current.kind === "measure") {
      setMeasure({ points: [current.start, point], cursor: null, finished: true });
    }
    if (current.kind === "snapshot") {
      const region: BBox = {
        x: Math.max(0, Math.min(current.start[0], point[0])),
        y: Math.max(0, Math.min(current.start[1], point[1])),
        width: Math.min(widthMm, Math.abs(point[0] - current.start[0])),
        height: Math.min(heightMm, Math.abs(point[1] - current.start[1])),
      };
      if (region.width > 2 && region.height > 2) void capture(region);
    }
    if (current.kind === "marquee") {
      const box: BBox = {
        x: Math.min(current.start[0], point[0]),
        y: Math.min(current.start[1], point[1]),
        width: Math.abs(point[0] - current.start[0]),
        height: Math.abs(point[1] - current.start[1]),
      };
      if (box.width > 0.6 || box.height > 0.6) selectInBox(box, current.additive);
    }
    if (current.kind === "lasso") selectInLasso(current.points);
    setDraft(null);
  };

  const onHandleDown = (handle: HandleId, event: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!bounds || chosen.length === 0) return;
    const point = toMm(event.clientX, event.clientY);
    const svg = svgRef.current;
    svg?.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    if (handle === "rotate") {
      const center: Pt = [bounds.x + bounds.width / 2, bounds.y + bounds.height / 2];
      const angle = (Math.atan2(point[1] - center[1], point[0] - center[0]) * 180) / Math.PI;
      interaction.current = { kind: "rotate", center, startAngle: angle, initial: structuredClone(chosen), pushed: false };
    } else {
      interaction.current = { kind: "scale", handle, box: bounds, initial: structuredClone(chosen), pushed: false };
    }
  };

  const saveStampFrom = async (region: BBox, label: string) => {
    const image = await capture(region);
    if (!image) return false;
    const result = await useCustomStampStore.getState().add({
      name: label,
      imageUrl: image.dataUrl,
      width: image.width,
      height: image.height,
    });
    if (!result.ok) {
      useUIStore.getState().setToast(`Stamp added for this session only: ${result.error ?? "storage failed"}`);
    }
    // Place the stamp that was just captured, never a factory fallback.
    if (result.stamp) useToolStore.getState().setStamp(result.stamp.id);
    useToolStore.getState().setTool("stamp");
    setSnap({ region, image, status: result.ok ? "Saved to stamps" : "Saved for this session" });
    return true;
  };

  const onAction = (action: SelectionAction) => {
    const store = useAnnotationStore.getState();
    const center: Pt = bounds ? [bounds.x + bounds.width / 2, bounds.y + bounds.height / 2] : [0, 0];
    if (action === "style") useUIStore.getState().openToolPopover();
    if (action === "duplicate") store.duplicateSelection();
    if (action === "delete") store.deleteSelection();
    if (action === "group") store.groupSelection();
    if (action === "ungroup") store.ungroupSelection();
    if (action === "lock") store.setLocked(!locked);
    if (action === "front") store.bringToFront();
    if (action === "back") store.sendToBack();
    if (action === "rotate") {
      useDocStore.getState().pushHistory(tab.id);
      applySelectionTransform("rotate", { origin: center, degrees: 90 });
    }
    if (action === "flip-h" || action === "flip-v") {
      useDocStore.getState().pushHistory(tab.id);
      applySelectionTransform("flip", { origin: center, axis: action === "flip-h" ? "h" : "v" });
    }
    if (action === "save-stamp" && bounds) {
      void saveStampFrom(bounds, `Selection ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}`).then((saved) => {
        if (!saved) return;
        useToolStore.getState().setTool("stamp");
        useUIStore.getState().setToast("Selection saved to the custom stamp gallery");
      });
    }
  };

  const commitMeasure = () => {
    const points = measure.points;
    const store = useAnnotationStore.getState();
    if (measureMode === "distance" && points.length >= 2) {
      const shape = shapeProps("dimension", points[0], points[1]);
      shape.strokeColor = "#0a84ff";
      shape.fillColor = null;
      shape.fillTransparent = true;
      shape.lineWidthMm = 0.35;
      shape.dimensionUnit = measureUnit;
      shape.dimensionScale = scale.denominator;
      store.add(shape);
    } else if ((measureMode === "area" || measureMode === "perimeter") && points.length >= 3) {
      const shape = shapeProps("polygon", points[0], points[points.length - 1]);
      shape.points = points;
      shape.strokeColor = "#0a84ff";
      shape.lineWidthMm = 0.35;
      shape.fillColor = measureMode === "area" ? "#9fd0ff" : null;
      shape.fillTransparent = measureMode !== "area";
      shape.opacity = measureMode === "area" ? 0.75 : 1;
      store.add(shape);
    } else if (measureMode === "angle" && points.length >= 3) {
      const degrees = angleAt(points[1], points[0], points[2]);
      const text: TextAnnotation = {
        id: makeId("a"),
        type: "text",
        xMm: points[0][0] + 3,
        yMm: points[0][1] + 3,
        widthMm: 20,
        heightMm: 7,
        text: `${degrees.toFixed(1)}°`,
        fontFamily: "Helvetica",
        fontSizePt: 9,
        textColor: "#0a84ff",
        bold: true,
        italic: false,
        underline: false,
        strikeOut: false,
        align: "left",
        script: "normal",
        boxFillColor: "#ffffff",
        boxFillTransparent: true,
        frameType: 0,
        frameColor: "#0a84ff",
        lineWidthMm: 0.3,
        autoFit: false,
        rotation: 0,
        opacity: 1,
      };
      store.add(text);
    }
    setMeasure({ points: [], cursor: null, finished: false });
  };

  const commitText = (text: string) => {
    const edit = textEdit;
    if (!edit) return;
    setTextEdit(null);
    const draftValue = { ...edit.draft, text };
    if (!text.trim()) {
      if (!edit.isNew) useAnnotationStore.getState().update([draftValue.id], { text: "" });
      return;
    }
    if (edit.isNew) {
      addSilently(draftValue);
      return;
    }
    useAnnotationStore.getState().update([draftValue.id], {
      text,
      widthMm: draftValue.widthMm,
      heightMm: draftValue.heightMm,
      fontFamily: draftValue.fontFamily,
      fontSizePt: draftValue.fontSizePt,
      textColor: draftValue.textColor,
      bold: draftValue.bold,
      italic: draftValue.italic,
      underline: draftValue.underline,
      strikeOut: draftValue.strikeOut,
      align: draftValue.align,
      script: draftValue.script,
      boxFillColor: draftValue.boxFillColor,
      boxFillTransparent: draftValue.boxFillTransparent,
      frameType: draftValue.frameType,
      frameColor: draftValue.frameColor,
      lineWidthMm: draftValue.lineWidthMm,
      autoFit: draftValue.autoFit,
      rotation: draftValue.rotation,
      opacity: draftValue.opacity,
    });
  };

  const saveFormula = (draftValue: FormulaDraft) => {
    const current = formulaEdit;
    if (!current) return;
    setFormulaEdit(null);
    const base: FormulaAnnotation = {
      ...current.annotation,
      latex: draftValue.latex,
      color: draftValue.color,
      fontSizePt: draftValue.fontSizePt,
      fillColor: draftValue.fillColor,
      fillTransparent: draftValue.fillTransparent,
      opacity: draftValue.opacity,
    };
    const exists = page.annotations.some((annotation) => annotation.id === base.id);
    const store = useAnnotationStore.getState();
    if (exists) {
      store.update([base.id], {
        latex: base.latex,
        color: base.color,
        fontSizePt: base.fontSizePt,
        fillColor: base.fillColor,
        fillTransparent: base.fillTransparent,
        opacity: base.opacity,
      });
    } else {
      addSilently(base);
    }
  };

  const cursor = panMode
    ? "grab"
    : activeTool === "select"
      ? "default"
      : activeTool === "eraser"
        ? "cell"
        : [
            "pen",
            "marker",
            "line",
            "arrow",
            "rectangle",
            "ellipse",
            "polygon",
            "dimension",
            "stamp",
            "lasso",
            "text",
            "formula",
            "measure",
            "snapshot",
            "image",
            "crop",
          ].includes(activeTool)
          ? "crosshair"
          : "default";

  const measureText = activeTool === "measure" ? measureSummary(measureMode, measure, scale.denominator, measureUnit) : null;
  const canCommitMeasure =
    (measureMode === "distance" && measure.points.length >= 2) ||
    ((measureMode === "area" || measureMode === "perimeter") && measure.points.length >= 3) ||
    (measureMode === "angle" && measure.points.length >= 3);
  const editingId = textEdit && !textEdit.isNew ? textEdit.draft.id : null;

  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ cursor }}>
      <input
        ref={imageInput}
        type="file"
        accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/svg+xml"
        className="hidden"
        aria-label="Insert image"
        onChange={(event) => {
          const file = event.target.files?.[0];
          event.target.value = "";
          if (!file) return;
          void readImageFile(file)
            .then((image) => addImageStamp(image, imagePoint.current ?? undefined))
            .catch(() => undefined);
        }}
      />
      <svg
        ref={svgRef}
        data-annotation-layer
        viewBox={`0 0 ${widthMm} ${heightMm}`}
        className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full"
        style={{ touchAction: CANVAS_TOUCH_ACTION, display: "block", overflow: "visible" }}
        onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
        onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
        onPointerUp={onPointerUp}
        onPointerCancel={() => {
          cancelLongPress();
          interaction.current = null;
          setDraft(null);
        }}
        onDoubleClick={(event) => {
          const point = toMm(event.clientX, event.clientY);
          const hit = [...page.annotations]
            .reverse()
            .find((annotation) => !annotation.hidden && (annotation.type === "text" || annotation.type === "formula") && hitTest(annotation, point));
          if (!hit) return;
          if (hit.type === "text") setTextEdit({ draft: hit, isNew: false });
          else if (hit.type === "formula") setFormulaEdit({ annotation: hit, anchor: { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY } });
        }}
      >
        <defs>
          <marker id="pm-arrow-3" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="5.5" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0 0 L6 3 L0 6" fill="none" stroke="context-stroke" strokeWidth="1.1" />
          </marker>
          <marker id="pm-arrow-5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="5.5" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0 0 L6 3 L0 6 Z" fill="context-stroke" />
          </marker>
          <marker id="pm-arrow-7" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" refX="6" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0 3.5 L3.5 0 L7 3.5 L3.5 7 Z" fill="context-stroke" />
          </marker>
          <marker id="pm-arrow-10" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" refX="6.4" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <circle cx="3.5" cy="3.5" r="2.7" fill="context-stroke" />
          </marker>
        </defs>

        {page.annotations
          .filter((annotation) => annotation.id !== editingId)
          .map((annotation) => (
            <AnnotationView key={annotation.id} annotation={annotation} />
          ))}

        {draft?.kind === "ink" &&
          (draft.tool === "pen" ? (
            <path
              d={inkPath(draft.points, toolProps.thicknessMm, {
                ...penStyleOptions(toolProps.penStyle, toolProps.pressureLevel),
                simulatePressure: false,
              })}
              fill={toolProps.color}
              opacity={toolProps.opacity}
            />
          ) : (
            (() => {
              const nib = markerNib(toolProps.tipStyle, toolProps.thicknessMm);
              return (
                <polyline
                  points={draft.points.map(([x, y]) => `${x},${y}`).join(" ")}
                  fill="none"
                  stroke={toolProps.color}
                  strokeWidth={nib.width}
                  strokeLinecap={nib.cap}
                  opacity={markerOpacity(toolProps.opacity)}
                  style={{ mixBlendMode: "multiply" }}
                />
              );
            })()
          ))}
        {draft?.kind === "shape" && <AnnotationView annotation={draft.shape} />}
        {draft?.kind === "marquee" && (
          <rect
            x={Math.min(draft.start[0], draft.end[0])}
            y={Math.min(draft.start[1], draft.end[1])}
            width={Math.abs(draft.end[0] - draft.start[0])}
            height={Math.abs(draft.end[1] - draft.start[1])}
            fill="var(--accent-soft)"
            stroke="var(--accent)"
            strokeWidth={0.3}
            strokeDasharray="1.6 1"
          />
        )}
        {draft?.kind === "lasso" && (
          <path
            d={polylinePath(draft.points, true)}
            fill="var(--accent-soft)"
            stroke="var(--accent)"
            strokeWidth={0.3}
            strokeDasharray="1.6 1"
          />
        )}
        {draft?.kind === "text" && (
          <rect
            x={Math.min(draft.start[0], draft.end[0])}
            y={Math.min(draft.start[1], draft.end[1])}
            width={Math.max(2, Math.abs(draft.end[0] - draft.start[0]))}
            height={Math.max(2, Math.abs(draft.end[1] - draft.start[1]))}
            fill="var(--accent-soft)"
            stroke="var(--accent)"
            strokeWidth={0.3}
            strokeDasharray="1.6 1"
          />
        )}
        {draft?.kind === "snapshot" && (
          <rect
            x={Math.min(draft.start[0], draft.end[0])}
            y={Math.min(draft.start[1], draft.end[1])}
            width={Math.abs(draft.end[0] - draft.start[0])}
            height={Math.abs(draft.end[1] - draft.start[1])}
            fill="var(--accent-soft)"
            stroke="var(--accent)"
            strokeWidth={0.3}
            strokeDasharray="1.6 1"
          />
        )}
        {draft?.kind === "stamp" &&
          (() => {
            const art = selectedStampId ? stampArt(selectedStampId) : null;
            const draggedW = Math.abs(draft.end[0] - draft.start[0]);
            const draggedH = Math.abs(draft.end[1] - draft.start[1]);
            const useDrag = draggedW > 1.5 && draggedH > 1.5;
            const width = useDrag ? draggedW : draft.widthMm;
            const height = useDrag ? draggedH : draft.heightMm;
            const x = useDrag ? Math.min(draft.start[0], draft.end[0]) : draft.start[0] - width / 2;
            const y = useDrag ? Math.min(draft.start[1], draft.end[1]) : draft.start[1] - height / 2;
            return (
              <g opacity={0.65}>
                {art?.imageUrl && (
                  <image href={art.imageUrl} x={x} y={y} width={width} height={height} preserveAspectRatio="none" />
                )}
                <rect x={x} y={y} width={width} height={height} fill="none" stroke="var(--accent)" strokeWidth={0.3} />
              </g>
            );
          })()}
        {activeTool === "measure" && <MeasureOverlay mode={measureMode} state={measure} />}
      </svg>

      {activeTool === "measure" && measureText && (
        <div
          className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-3 left-1/2 z-20"
          style={{ transform: `translateX(-50%) scale(${1 / zoom})`, transformOrigin: "bottom center" }}
        >
          <div className="glass-strong pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] shadow-lg" onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
            <span className="whitespace-nowrap font-medium tabular-nums">{measureText}</span>
            <button type="button" className="chip h-6 px-2" disabled={!canCommitMeasure} onClick={commitMeasure}>
              Commit
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="chip h-6 px-2"
              onClick={() => setMeasure({ points: [], cursor: null, finished: false })}
            >
              Clear
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {snap && (
        <SnapshotBar
          region={snap.region}
          imageUrl={snap.image?.dataUrl ?? null}
          zoom={zoom}
          widthMm={widthMm}
          heightMm={heightMm}
          status={snap.status}
          onCopy={() => {
            if (!snap.image) return;
            void (async () => {
              try {
                const blob = await (await fetch(snap.image!.dataUrl)).blob();
                await navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({ "image/png": blob })]);
                setSnap((state) => (state ? { ...state, status: "Copied" } : state));
              } catch {
                setSnap((state) => (state ? { ...state, status: "Copy blocked" } : state));
              }
            })();
          }}
          onDownload={() => {
            if (!snap.image) return;
            const anchor = document.createElement("a");
            anchor.href = snap.image.dataUrl;
            anchor.download = `snapshot-${Date.now()}.png`;
            document.body.appendChild(anchor);
            anchor.click();
            anchor.remove();
            setSnap((state) => (state ? { ...state, status: "Downloaded" } : state));
          }}
          onSaveStamp={() => void saveStampFrom(snap.region, `Snapshot ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}`)}
          onClose={() => setSnap(null)}
        />
      )}

      {textEdit && (
        <TextEditor
          draft={textEdit.draft}
          onPatch={(patch: AnnotationPatch) =>
            setTextEdit((state) => (state ? { ...state, draft: { ...state.draft, ...patch } } : state))
          }
          onFit={(text) =>
            setTextEdit((state) =>
              state ? { ...state, draft: { ...state.draft, ...fitTextBox({ ...state.draft, text }) } } : state,
            )
          }
          onCommit={commitText}
          onCancel={() => setTextEdit(null)}
        />
      )}

      {formulaEdit &&
        typeof document !== "undefined" &&
        createPortal(
          <FormulaEditor
            initial={{
              latex: formulaEdit.annotation.latex,
              color: formulaEdit.annotation.color,
              fontSizePt: formulaEdit.annotation.fontSizePt,
              fillColor: formulaEdit.annotation.fillColor,
              fillTransparent: formulaEdit.annotation.fillTransparent,
              opacity: formulaEdit.annotation.opacity,
            }}
            anchor={formulaEdit.anchor}
            onSave={saveFormula}
            onClose={() => setFormulaEdit(null)}
          />,
          document.body,
        )}

      <SelectionOverlay
        bounds={bounds}
        count={chosen.length}
        zoom={zoom}
        pageWidthMm={widthMm}
        locked={locked}
        grouped={grouped}
        onHandleDown={onHandleDown}
        onAction={onAction}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Check, RotateCcw, X } from "lucide-react";
import type { DocumentPage } from "../../lib/types";
import { PX_PER_MM } from "../../lib/paper";

type CropBox = NonNullable<DocumentPage["cropBox"]>;
type Mode = "move" | "nw" | "n" | "ne" | "e" | "se" | "s" | "sw" | "w";
type RatioId = "free" | "a4" | "16:9" | "1:1";

interface Props {
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  cropBox?: CropBox;
  zoom: number;
  onApply: (box: CropBox | null) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

const MIN_MM = 10;
const HANDLES: { mode: Mode; x: number; y: number; cursor: string }[] = [
  { mode: "nw", x: 0, y: 0, cursor: "nwse-resize" },
  { mode: "n", x: 0.5, y: 0, cursor: "ns-resize" },
  { mode: "ne", x: 1, y: 0, cursor: "nesw-resize" },
  { mode: "e", x: 1, y: 0.5, cursor: "ew-resize" },
  { mode: "se", x: 1, y: 1, cursor: "nwse-resize" },
  { mode: "s", x: 0.5, y: 1, cursor: "ns-resize" },
  { mode: "sw", x: 0, y: 1, cursor: "nesw-resize" },
  { mode: "w", x: 0, y: 0.5, cursor: "ew-resize" },
];

const RATIOS: { id: RatioId; label: string; ratio: number | null }[] = [
  { id: "free", label: "Free", ratio: null },
  { id: "a4", label: "A4", ratio: 210 / 297 },
  { id: "16:9", label: "16:9", ratio: 16 / 9 },
  { id: "1:1", label: "1:1", ratio: 1 },
];

const fullPage = (widthMm: number, heightMm: number): CropBox => ({ xMm: 0, yMm: 0, widthMm, heightMm });

/** A 10 mm inset gives the frame something to grab the moment Crop opens. */
const insetPage = (widthMm: number, heightMm: number): CropBox =>
  clampBox({ xMm: 10, yMm: 10, widthMm: widthMm - 20, heightMm: heightMm - 20 }, widthMm, heightMm);

function clampBox(box: CropBox, widthMm: number, heightMm: number): CropBox {
  const width = Math.max(MIN_MM, Math.min(box.widthMm, widthMm));
  const height = Math.max(MIN_MM, Math.min(box.heightMm, heightMm));
  return {
    xMm: Math.max(0, Math.min(box.xMm, widthMm - width)),
    yMm: Math.max(0, Math.min(box.yMm, heightMm - height)),
    widthMm: width,
    heightMm: height,
  };
}

function centeredRatio(widthMm: number, heightMm: number, ratio: number): CropBox {
  let width = widthMm;
  let height = width / ratio;
  if (height > heightMm) {
    height = heightMm;
    width = height * ratio;
  }
  return { xMm: (widthMm - width) / 2, yMm: (heightMm - height) / 2, widthMm: width, heightMm: height };
}

/** Interactive crop frame drawn over the page, in page-local millimetres. */
export function CropOverlay({ widthMm, heightMm, cropBox, zoom, onApply, onCancel }: Props) {
  const [box, setBox] = useState<CropBox>(() => cropBox ?? insetPage(widthMm, heightMm));
  const [ratio, setRatio] = useState<RatioId>("free");
  const drag = useRef<{ mode: Mode; startX: number; startY: number; box: CropBox } | null>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const hit = 24 / zoom;
  const dot = 12 / zoom;

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key !== "Escape") return;
      event.stopPropagation();
      onCancel();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown, true);
  }, [onCancel]);

  const toMm = (event: React.PointerEvent) => {
    // The handles capture pointers, so page-local coordinates always come from the container.
    const rect = containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    return {
      x: (event.clientX - rect.left) / (zoom * PX_PER_MM),
      y: (event.clientY - rect.top) / (zoom * PX_PER_MM),
    };
  };

  const begin = (mode: Mode) => (event: React.PointerEvent) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    event.preventDefault();
    const point = toMm(event);
    drag.current = { mode, startX: point.x, startY: point.y, box };
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  };

  const move = (event: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const current = drag.current;
    if (!current) return;
    const point = toMm(event);
    const dx = point.x - current.startX;
    const dy = point.y - current.startY;
    const base = current.box;
    let next = { ...base };
    const mode = current.mode;
    if (mode === "move") {
      next.xMm = base.xMm + dx;
      next.yMm = base.yMm + dy;
    } else {
      if (mode.includes("w")) {
        next.xMm = base.xMm + dx;
        next.widthMm = base.widthMm - dx;
      }
      if (mode.includes("e")) next.widthMm = base.widthMm + dx;
      if (mode.includes("n")) {
        next.yMm = base.yMm + dy;
        next.heightMm = base.heightMm - dy;
      }
      if (mode.includes("s")) next.heightMm = base.heightMm + dy;
      if (next.widthMm < MIN_MM) {
        next.widthMm = MIN_MM;
        if (mode.includes("w")) next.xMm = base.xMm + base.widthMm - MIN_MM;
      }
      if (next.heightMm < MIN_MM) {
        next.heightMm = MIN_MM;
        if (mode.includes("n")) next.yMm = base.yMm + base.heightMm - MIN_MM;
      }
    }
    setRatio("free");
    setBox(clampBox(next, widthMm, heightMm));
  };

  const end = () => {
    drag.current = null;
  };

  const px = (value: number) => value * PX_PER_MM;
  const left = px(box.xMm);
  const top = px(box.yMm);
  const width = px(box.widthMm);
  const height = px(box.heightMm);
  const pageWidthPx = px(widthMm);

  // Keep the bar inside the page box even when the crop sits at an edge.
  const barHalf = 200 / zoom;
  const barLeft =
    pageWidthPx < barHalf * 2
      ? pageWidthPx / 2
      : Math.max(barHalf, Math.min(pageWidthPx - barHalf, left + width / 2));

  const isFullPage = box.xMm <= 0.5 && box.yMm <= 0.5 && box.widthMm >= widthMm - 0.5 && box.heightMm >= heightMm - 0.5;

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className="crop-overlay absolute inset-0 z-30 select-none"
      style={{ touchAction: "none", cursor: "crosshair" }}
      onPointerMove={move}
      onPointerUp={end}
      onPointerCancel={end}
      onPointerDown={(event) => {
        if (event.target !== event.currentTarget) return;
        begin("move")(event);
      }}
    >
      <div
        className="absolute border border-white/80"
        style={{ left, top, width, height, boxShadow: "0 0 0 9999px rgba(9, 11, 16, 0.35)" }}
        onPointerDown={begin("move")}
      >
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0">
          <div className="absolute left-1/3 top-0 h-full w-px bg-white/45" />
          <div className="absolute left-2/3 top-0 h-full w-px bg-white/45" />
          <div className="absolute left-0 top-1/3 h-px w-full bg-white/45" />
          <div className="absolute left-0 top-2/3 h-px w-full bg-white/45" />
        </div>
        {HANDLES.map((handle) => (
          <button
            key={handle.mode}
            type="button"
            aria-label={`Crop ${handle.mode}`}
            className="absolute grid place-items-center bg-transparent"
            style={{
              left: `calc(${handle.x * 100}% - ${hit / 2}px)`,
              top: `calc(${handle.y * 100}% - ${hit / 2}px)`,
              width: hit,
              height: hit,
              cursor: handle.cursor,
              touchAction: "none",
            }}
            onPointerDown={begin(handle.mode)}
          >
            <span
              className="rounded-sm border border-[var(--accent)] bg-white"
              style={{ width: dot, height: dot }}
            />
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div
        className="absolute z-40"
        style={{
          left: barLeft,
          top: Math.max(16, top - 44),
          transform: `translateX(-50%) scale(${1 / zoom})`,
          transformOrigin: "top center",
        }}
      >
        <div className="glass-strong flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2 py-1.5 shadow-lg">
          <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-[11px] font-medium tabular-nums">
            {box.widthMm.toFixed(1)} × {box.heightMm.toFixed(1)} mm
          </span>
          <div className="seg">
            {RATIOS.map((option) => (
              <button
                key={option.id}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={ratio === option.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setRatio(option.id);
                  if (option.ratio !== null) setBox(centeredRatio(widthMm, heightMm, option.ratio));
                }}
              >
                {option.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <button type="button" className="chip h-6 px-2" onClick={() => { setRatio("free"); setBox(fullPage(widthMm, heightMm)); }}>
            <RotateCcw size={11} /> Reset
          </button>
          <button type="button" className="chip h-6 px-2" onClick={onCancel}>
            <X size={11} /> Cancel
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="chip h-6 px-2"
            onClick={() => onApply(isFullPage ? null : clampBox(box, widthMm, heightMm))}
          >
            <Check size={11} /> Apply
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export interface FormulaDraft {

const PALETTES: { name: string; items: { label: string; insert: string }[] }[] = [

      { label: "≥", insert: "\\ge" },
      { label: "→", insert: "\\to" },
      { label: "⇒", insert: "\\Rightarrow" },
      { label: "↔", insert: "\\leftrightarrow" },
    ],
  },
];

/** Panel size, so a caller can centre the editor on a point. */
export const FORMULA_PANEL = { width: 360, height: 520 };

interface Props {
  initial: FormulaDraft;
  anchor: { x: number; y: number };
  onSave: (draft: FormulaDraft) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function FormulaEditor({ initial, anchor, onSave, onClose }: Props) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<FormulaDraft>(initial);
  const [html, setHtml] = useState("");
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    textareaRef.current?.focus();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    void latexToHtml(draft.latex).then((markup) => {
      if (alive) setHtml(markup);
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [draft.latex]);

  const position = useMemo(() => {
    const { width, height } = FORMULA_PANEL;
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return { left: anchor.x, top: anchor.y };
    return {
      left: Math.max(8, Math.min(anchor.x, window.innerWidth - width - 8)),
      top: Math.max(8, Math.min(anchor.y, window.innerHeight - height - 8)),
    };
  }, [anchor.x, anchor.y]);

  const insert = (snippet: string) => {
    const textarea = textareaRef.current;
    if (!textarea) {
      setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, latex: current.latex + snippet }));
      return;
    }
    const start = textarea.selectionStart;
    const end = textarea.selectionEnd;
    const latex = draft.latex.slice(0, start) + snippet + draft.latex.slice(end);
    setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, latex }));
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      const caret = start + snippet.length;
      textarea.focus();
      textarea.setSelectionRange(caret, caret);
    }, 0);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="glass-strong anim-in no-scrollbar fixed z-[60] flex w-[360px] flex-col gap-2.5 rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-2xl"
      style={position}
      role="dialog"
      aria-label="LaTeX formula editor"
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === "Escape") {
          event.preventDefault();
          onClose();
        }
      }}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold">Formula studio</div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button type="button" className="icon-btn h-7 w-7" title="Close (Esc)" aria-label="Close formula editor" onClick={onClose}>
            <X size={13} />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="chip h-7 px-2"
            aria-label="Apply formula"
            onClick={() => onSave({ ...draft, latex: draft.latex.trim() ? draft.latex : "\\;" })}
          >
            <Check size={12} /> Apply
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <textarea
        ref={textareaRef}
        className="no-scrollbar min-h-[64px] resize-y rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--glass)] p-2 font-mono text-[11.5px]"
        aria-label="LaTeX source"
        spellCheck={false}
        value={draft.latex}
        onChange={(event) => setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, latex: event.target.value }))}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === "Enter" && (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            onSave(draft);
          }
        }}
      />

      <div
        className="no-scrollbar flex min-h-[42px] items-center justify-center overflow-x-auto rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5"
        style={{ background: "var(--paper)", color: draft.color, maxHeight: 84 }}
        aria-label="Formula preview"
      >
        <div style={{ fontSize: 15 }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html }} />
      </div>

      <div className="no-scrollbar flex max-h-[186px] flex-col gap-1.5 overflow-y-auto pr-0.5">
        {PALETTES.map((group) => (
          <div key={group.name} className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <span className="text-[9.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.07em] text-muted">{group.name}</span>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
              {group.items.map((item) => (
                <button
                  key={item.insert}
                  type="button"
                  className="chip h-6 px-1.5 font-mono text-[10px]"
                  title={item.insert}
                  onClick={() => insert(item.insert)}
                >
                  {item.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <ColorRow label="Text colour" value={draft.color} onChange={(value) => value && setDraft((c) => ({ ...c, color: value }))} />
      <SliderRow
        label="Font size"
        value={draft.fontSizePt}
        min={6}
        max={96}
        step={0.5}
        unit="pt"
        onChange={(value) => setDraft((c) => ({ ...c, fontSizePt: value }))}
      />
      <ColorRow
        label="Fill"
        value={draft.fillTransparent ? null : draft.fillColor}
        allowNone
        onChange={(value) =>
          setDraft((c) => ({ ...c, fillColor: value ?? c.fillColor, fillTransparent: value === null }))
        }
      />
      <SliderRow
        label="Opacity"
        value={Math.round(draft.opacity * 100)}
        min={5}
        max={100}
        step={1}
        unit="%"
        onChange={(value) => setDraft((c) => ({ ...c, opacity: value / 100 }))}
      />
      <ToggleRow
        label="Transparent fill"
        checked={draft.fillTransparent}
        onChange={(checked) => setDraft((c) => ({ ...c, fillTransparent: checked }))}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { FormulaAnnotation } from "../../lib/annotationTypes";
import { latexToHtml } from "../../lib/formula";
import { PT_TO_MM } from "../../lib/textLayout";

/** KaTeX renders inside a foreignObject so the formula scales with the page. */
export function FormulaView({ annotation }: { annotation: FormulaAnnotation }) {
  const [html, setHtml] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    void latexToHtml(annotation.latex).then((markup) => {
      if (alive) setHtml(markup);
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [annotation.latex]);

  const cx = annotation.xMm + annotation.widthMm / 2;
  const cy = annotation.yMm + annotation.heightMm / 2;
  const fontSizeMm = annotation.fontSizePt * PT_TO_MM;

  return (
    <g transform={`rotate(${annotation.rotation} ${cx} ${cy})`} opacity={annotation.opacity}>
      {!annotation.fillTransparent && (
        <rect
          x={annotation.xMm}
          y={annotation.yMm}
          width={annotation.widthMm}
          height={annotation.heightMm}
          fill={annotation.fillColor}
        />
      )}
      <foreignObject
        x={annotation.xMm}
        y={annotation.yMm}
        width={annotation.widthMm}
        height={annotation.heightMm}
        style={{ overflow: "visible" }}
      >
        <div
          style={{
            width: "100%",
            height: "100%",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            fontSize: `${fontSizeMm}mm`,
            color: annotation.color,
            lineHeight: 1.15,
          }}
          dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html }}
        />
      </foreignObject>
    </g>
  );
}

import type { Pt } from "../../lib/annotationTypes";
import { angleAt, distanceStats, formatArea, formatLength, polygonArea, polylineLength } from "../../lib/measure";
import type { MeasureMode, MeasureUnit } from "../../lib/measure";

export interface MeasureState {
  points: Pt[];
  cursor: Pt | null;
  finished: boolean;
}

/** Live numbers for the pill above the page. */export function measureSummary(mode: MeasureMode, state: MeasureState, scale: number, unit: MeasureUnit): string | null {
  const points = state.cursor ? [...state.points, state.cursor] : state.points;
  if (mode === "distance") {
    const [a, b] = points;
    if (!a || !b) return null;
    const stats = distanceStats(a, b);
    return `${formatLength(stats.distance, scale, unit)} · ΔX ${formatLength(Math.abs(stats.dx), scale, unit)} · ΔY ${formatLength(
      Math.abs(stats.dy),
      scale,
      unit,
    )} · ${stats.angle.toFixed(1)}°`;
  }
  if (mode === "perimeter") {
    if (points.length < 2) return null;
    return `${points.length} points · ${formatLength(polylineLength(points), scale, unit)}`;
  }
  if (mode === "area") {
    const closed = points.length >= 3 ? points : state.points;
    if (closed.length < 3) return null;
    return `${formatArea(polygonArea(closed), scale, unit)} · perimeter ${formatLength(
      polylineLength([...closed, closed[0]]),
      scale,
      unit,
    )}`;
  }
  const [vertex, first, second] = points;
  if (!vertex || !first || !second) return null;
  return `${angleAt(first, vertex, second).toFixed(1)}°`;
}

/** Transient measurement preview; nothing here is persisted until Commit. */
export function MeasureOverlay({ mode, state }: { mode: MeasureMode; state: MeasureState }) {
  const points = state.cursor ? [...state.points, state.cursor] : state.points;
  const solid = state.finished;
  const stroke = "var(--accent)";

  if (mode === "distance") {
    const [a, b] = points;
    return (
      <g fill="none" stroke={stroke} strokeWidth={0.45}>
        {a && b && <line x1={a[0]} y1={a[1]} x2={b[0]} y2={b[1]} strokeDasharray={solid ? undefined : "1.6 1"} />}
        {points.map((point, index) => (
          <circle key={index} cx={point[0]} cy={point[1]} r={0.9} fill="var(--paper)" />
        ))}
      </g>
    );
  }

  if (mode === "perimeter") {
    return (
      <g fill="none" stroke={stroke} strokeWidth={0.45}>
        <polyline points={points.map((point) => point.join(",")).join(" ")} strokeDasharray={solid ? undefined : "1.6 1"} />
        {points.map((point, index) => (
          <circle key={index} cx={point[0]} cy={point[1]} r={index === 0 ? 1 : 0.8} fill="var(--paper)" />
        ))}
      </g>
    );
  }

  if (mode === "area") {
    const closed = points.length >= 3 ? points : state.points;
    return (
      <g fill="none" stroke={stroke} strokeWidth={0.45}>
        {closed.length >= 2 && (
          <polygon
            points={closed.map((point) => point.join(",")).join(" ")}
            fill="var(--accent-soft)"
            strokeDasharray={solid ? undefined : "1.6 1"}
          />
        )}
        {state.points.map((point, index) => (
          <circle key={index} cx={point[0]} cy={point[1]} r={index === 0 ? 1 : 0.8} fill="var(--paper)" />
        ))}
      </g>
    );
  }

  const vertex = state.points[0];
  const first = state.points[1];
  const second = state.points[2] ?? state.cursor;
  const radius = 10;
  let arc = "";
  if (vertex && first && second) {
    const a1 = Math.atan2(first[1] - vertex[1], first[0] - vertex[0]);
    const a2 = Math.atan2(second[1] - vertex[1], second[0] - vertex[0]);
    const p1: Pt = [vertex[0] + Math.cos(a1) * radius, vertex[1] + Math.sin(a1) * radius];
    const p2: Pt = [vertex[0] + Math.cos(a2) * radius, vertex[1] + Math.sin(a2) * radius];
    const sweep = ((a2 - a1 + Math.PI * 2) % (Math.PI * 2)) > Math.PI ? 0 : 1;
    arc = `M ${p1[0]} ${p1[1]} A ${radius} ${radius} 0 0 ${sweep} ${p2[0]} ${p2[1]}`;
  }
  return (
    <g fill="none" stroke={stroke} strokeWidth={0.45}>
      {vertex && first && <line x1={vertex[0]} y1={vertex[1]} x2={first[0]} y2={first[1]} />}
      {vertex && second && (
        <line x1={vertex[0]} y1={vertex[1]} x2={second[0]} y2={second[1]} strokeDasharray={solid ? undefined : "1.6 1"} />
      )}
      {arc && <path d={arc} strokeWidth={0.35} />}
      {state.points.map((point, index) => (
        <circle key={index} cx={point[0]} cy={point[1]} r={index === 0 ? 1.1 : 0.8} fill="var(--paper)" />
      ))}
    </g>
  );
}

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { PX_PER_MM, pageMm, paperGeometry } from "../../lib/paper";
import type { PaperTemplate } from "../../lib/types";

interface PaperSheetProps {
  template: PaperTemplate;
  landscape?: boolean;
  /** Dashed margin and centre guides for aligning annotations. */
  aux?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Parametric paper engine: one SVG per recipe, drawn in millimetres so every
 * line width and margin survives zooming without re-rasterising.
 */
export function PaperSheet({ template, landscape = false, aux = false, className = "" }: PaperSheetProps) {
  const geometry = useMemo(() => paperGeometry(template, landscape), [template, landscape]);
  const page = pageMm(template, landscape);
  const widthPx = page.widthMm * PX_PER_MM;
  const heightPx = page.heightMm * PX_PER_MM;
  const bounds = template.bounds;

  return (
    <div
      className={`paper-shadow overflow-hidden ${className}`}
      style={{ width: widthPx, height: heightPx }}
      data-template={template.id}
    >
      <svg
        viewBox={`0 0 ${geometry.widthMm} ${geometry.heightMm}`}
        width={widthPx}
        height={heightPx}
        role="img"
        aria-label={`${template.name} paper`}
        style={{ display: "block" }}
      >
        <rect width={geometry.widthMm} height={geometry.heightMm} fill="var(--paper)" />
        {geometry.hasGrid && (
          <g fill="none" stroke={geometry.color}>
            {/* Screen hairlines: non-scaling keeps 0.1 mm rules readable at every zoom. */}
            {geometry.base && (
              <path d={geometry.base} strokeWidth={0.7} vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" opacity={0.6} />
            )}
            {geometry.minor && (
              <path d={geometry.minor} strokeWidth={0.9} vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" opacity={0.8} />
            )}
            {geometry.major && (
              <path d={geometry.major} strokeWidth={1.1} vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" />
            )}
          </g>
        )}
        {aux && (
          <g
            fill="none"
            stroke="var(--accent)"
            strokeWidth={1}
            strokeDasharray="4 3"
            vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
            opacity={0.55}
          >
            <line x1={geometry.widthMm / 2} y1="0" x2={geometry.widthMm / 2} y2={geometry.heightMm} />
            <line x1="0" y1={geometry.heightMm / 2} x2={geometry.widthMm} y2={geometry.heightMm / 2} />
            {bounds && (
              <rect
                x={bounds.left}
                y={bounds.top}
                width={geometry.widthMm - bounds.left - bounds.right}
                height={geometry.heightMm - bounds.top - bounds.bottom}
              />
            )}
          </g>
        )}
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { FileText, Image as ImageIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { clamp, clampPan, getWorkspaceInsets, PX_PER_MM, workspaceSafeArea, type PanOffset } from "../../lib/paper";
